sentences.text: CHAPTER ONE
sentences.translation: الفصل الأول

sentences.text: The Letter
sentences.translation: الرسالة

sentences.text: My name is Captain Arthur Hastings.
sentences.translation: اسمي الكابتن آرثر هاستينغز.

sentences.text: My wife and I have a large farm in South America, but before I was married I lived in London.
sentences.translation: أنا وزوجتي لدينا مزرعة كبيرة في أمريكا الجنوبية، لكن قبل أن أتزوج كنت أعيش في لندن.

sentences.text: There I helped my friend, the famous Belgian detective Hercule Poirot, solve many crimes.
sentences.translation: هناك ساعدت صديقي، المحقق البلجيكي الشهير هرقل بوارو، في حل العديد من الجرائم.

sentences.text: Poirot used to work with the police in Belgium, but he retired several years ago.
sentences.translation: كان بوارو يعمل مع الشرطة في بلجيكا، لكنه تقاعد منذ عدة سنوات.

sentences.text: Since retiring, though, he has become a very successful private detective.
sentences.translation: منذ تقاعده، أصبح محققاً خاصاً ناجحاً جداً.

sentences.text: When the British police have a difficult crime which they cannot solve, they often ask Poirot to help them.
sentences.translation: عندما تواجه الشرطة البريطانية جريمة صعبة لا تستطيع حلها، غالباً ما تطلب من بوارو مساعدتها.

sentences.text: In June 1935 I came back to Britain for six months on business while my wife stayed in South America to manage the farm.
sentences.translation: في يونيو 1935 عدت إلى بريطانيا لمدة ستة أشهر في مهمة عمل بينما بقيت زوجتي في أمريكا الجنوبية لإدارة المزرعة.

sentences.text: I didn't know that, during that time, I was going to work with my old friend Poirot again.
sentences.translation: لم أكن أعلم أنه خلال ذلك الوقت، سأعمل مع صديقي القديم بوارو مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: Most of this story is my own personal experience.
sentences.translation: معظم هذه القصة هي تجربتي الشخصية.

sentences.text: Sometimes, though, I have included information about events when I was not present myself.
sentences.translation: لكن في بعض الأحيان، أدرجت معلومات عن أحداث لم أكن حاضراً فيها بنفسي.

sentences.text: But I believe I have described the thoughts and feelings of the other people in the story correctly.
sentences.translation: لكني أعتقد أنني وصفت أفكار ومشاعر الأشخاص الآخرين في القصة بشكل صحيح.

sentences.text: Poirot has seen my work, and agrees that I have.
sentences.translation: لقد رأى بوارو عملي، ويوافق على أنني فعلت ذلك.

sentences.text: In my opinion, Poirot used his skills in a most clever and unusual way to solve a number of crimes which were different from any others that he had worked on.
sentences.translation: في رأيي، استخدم بوارو مهاراته بطريقة ذكية وغير عادية لحل عدد من الجرائم التي كانت مختلفة عن أي جرائم أخرى عمل عليها.

sentences.text: I shall call these crimes the ABC Murders.
sentences.translation: سأسمي هذه الجرائم جرائم ABC.

sentences.text: After arriving in England, I went almost immediately to visit Poirot.
sentences.translation: بعد وصولي إلى إنجلترا، ذهبت على الفور تقريباً لزيارة بوارو.

sentences.text: He had moved to a new flat in London and was very pleased to see me.
sentences.translation: كان قد انتقل إلى شقة جديدة في لندن وكان سعيداً جداً برؤيتي.

sentences.text: 'You're looking wonderful, Poirot,' I said.
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'You haven't changed at all.'
In fact, if it were possible, I would say that you have fewer grey hairs than the last time I saw you.
sentences.translation: في الواقع، لو كان ذلك ممكناً، أود أن أقول إن لديك شعراً رمادياً أقل من آخر مرة رأيتك فيها.

sentences.text: Poirot smiled.
sentences.translation: ابتسم بوارو.

sentences.text: 'And why is that not possible? It is quite true.'
'Do you mean your hair is turning from grey to black instead of from black to grey?' I said in surprise.
sentences.translation: قلت بدهشة.

sentences.text: That's very strange. It seems against nature.
sentences.translation: هذا غريب جداً. يبدو مخالفاً للطبيعة.

sentences.text: 'As usual, Hastings,' said Poirot, 'you have a beautiful and unsuspicious mind.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو،

sentences.text: You have not changed over the years.
sentences.translation: لم تتغير على مر السنين.

sentences.text: You notice a strange fact and explain it in the same breath without noticing that you are doing so!
sentences.translation: تلاحظ حقيقة غريبة وتشرحها في نفس النفس دون أن تلاحظ أنك تفعل ذلك!

sentences.text: Poirot walked into his bedroom and returned with a bottle in his hand.
sentences.translation: دخل بوارو إلى غرفة نومه وعاد وزجاجة في يده.

sentences.text: I looked at it, then I understood. It was a bottle of black hair colouring.
sentences.translation: نظرت إليها، ثم فهمت. كانت زجاجة صبغة شعر سوداء.

sentences.text: 'Poirot!' I cried. 'You've coloured your hair!'
sentences.translation: صرخت.

sentences.text: 'Oh, you begin to understand!' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'I suppose next time I come home, I shall find you wearing a false moustache - or are you wearing one now?'
Poirot looked shocked. He has a large black moustache which he is very proud of.
sentences.translation: بدا بوارو مصدوماً. لديه شارب أسود كبير يفتخر به كثيراً.

sentences.text: 'No, no, mon ami. A false moustache! How horrible!'
He pulled his moustache to prove to me that it was real.
sentences.translation: شد شاربه ليثبت لي أنه حقيقي.

sentences.text: 'I have never seen a moustache like mine in the whole of London.'
That was a very good thing, I thought privately.
sentences.translation: كان ذلك شيئاً جيداً جداً، فكرت في نفسي.

sentences.text: But I didn't want to hurt Poirot's feelings, so instead I changed the subject.
sentences.translation: لكني لم أرد إيذاء مشاعر بوارو، فبدلاً من ذلك غيرت الموضوع.

sentences.text: 'Are you still working?' I asked. 'I know you actually retired years ago.'
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'Yes, it is true,' replied Poirot.
sentences.translation: رد بوارو.

sentences.text: 'I tried to grow vegetables instead. But immediately, a murder happened - and I had to forget about the vegetables.'
And since then, whenever I say that a case will be my last, it is not.
sentences.translation: ومنذ ذلك الحين، كلما قلت إن قضية ستكون الأخيرة لي، لا تكون كذلك.

sentences.text: Each time I say: this is the end. But then something else happens.
sentences.translation: في كل مرة أقول: هذه هي النهاية. لكن ثم يحدث شيء آخر.

sentences.text: But I must say, my friend, that I do not like retirement at all.
sentences.translation: لكن يجب أن أقول يا صديقي، إنني لا أحب التقاعد على الإطلاق.

sentences.text: If I do not use my brain, it will stop working.
sentences.translation: إذا لم أستخدم عقلي، سيتوقف عن العمل.

sentences.text: 'I see,' I said. 'So you still use your brain sometimes.'
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'Exactly. But I choose my cases very carefully. You know, Hastings, in many ways I think you bring me luck.'
'Really?' I said. 'In what ways?'
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: As soon as I heard you were coming, I said to myself: something will happen.
sentences.translation: بمجرد أن سمعت أنك قادم، قلت لنفسي: شيء ما سيحدث.

sentences.text: Hastings and I will hunt criminals again together, just like the old days.
sentences.translation: هاستينغز وأنا سنطارد المجرمين معاً مرة أخرى، تماماً كما في الأيام الخوالي.

sentences.text: But if so, it must not be ordinary business.
sentences.translation: لكن إذا كان الأمر كذلك، فلا يجب أن يكون عملاً عادياً.

sentences.text: It must be something - he waved his hands excitedly - 'something very fine and special.'
sentences.translation: يجب أن يكون شيئاً - لوّح بيديه بحماس -

sentences.text: 'Well,' I said at last, smiling, 'has this excellent crime happened yet?'
sentences.translation: قلت أخيراً، مبتسماً،

sentences.text: 'Pas encore! At least -' Poirot paused, and a look of worry came over his face.
sentences.translation: توقف بوارو، وظهرت نظرة قلق على وجهه.

sentences.text: His voice sounded so strange that I looked at him in surprise.
sentences.translation: بدا صوته غريباً جداً لدرجة أنني نظرت إليه بدهشة.

sentences.text: Suddenly he crossed the room to a desk near the window.
sentences.translation: فجأة عبر الغرفة إلى مكتب بالقرب من النافذة.

sentences.text: There were papers arranged carefully inside. He took one out, then passed it to me.
sentences.translation: كانت هناك أوراق مرتبة بعناية في الداخل. أخرج واحدة، ثم مررها لي.

sentences.text: 'Tell me, mon ami.' he said. 'What do you think of this?'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: I took it from him with interest. It was a letter which had been typed on thick white notepaper:
sentences.translation: أخذتها منه باهتمام. كانت رسالة مطبوعة على ورق أبيض سميك:

sentences.text: Mr Hercule Poirot, You think you are very clever at solving mysteries that are too difficult for our poor, stupid British police.
sentences.translation: سيد هرقل بوارو، أنت تعتقد أنك ذكي جداً في حل الألغاز الصعبة جداً على شرطتنا البريطانية المسكينة والغبية.

sentences.text: Let us see, Mr Clever Poirot, just how clever you can be. Perhaps you'll find this problem too difficult.
sentences.translation: لنرى، سيد بوارو الذكي، كم يمكن أن تكون ذكياً. ربما تجد هذه المشكلة صعبة جداً.

sentences.text: Watch out for Andover, on the 21st of the month.
sentences.translation: احترس من أندوفر، في الحادي والعشرين من الشهر.

sentences.text: Yours, ABC
sentences.translation: المخلص، ABC

sentences.text: I looked at the envelope. The address was typed, too.
sentences.translation: نظرت إلى الظرف. كان العنوان مطبوعاً أيضاً.

sentences.text: 'The postmark is London WC1,' said Poirot. 'Well, what is your opinion?'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: I handed the letter back to him.
sentences.translation: أعدت الرسالة إليه.

sentences.text: 'It's from a madman, I suppose,' I said.
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'That is all you can say?'
'Well - doesn't it sound like a madman to you?'
'Yes, my friend, it does.'
His voice was serious. I looked at him in surprise.
sentences.translation: كان صوته جاداً. نظرت إليه بدهشة.

sentences.text: 'You're worried, Poirot.'
'A madman, mon ami is a serious matter. A madman is a very dangerous thing.'
'Yes, of course, that's true... I hadn't thought about that. But it sounds more like a rather stupid kind of joke. Perhaps the sender was drunk.'
'You may be right, Hastings.'
'What have you done about it?' I asked.
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'What can one do? I showed the letter to our good friend, Chief Inspector Japp. He thought the same as you - that it was a stupid joke.'
They get letters like these every day at Scotland Yard.
sentences.translation: يتلقون رسائل مثل هذه كل يوم في سكوتلاند يارد.

sentences.text: I, too, have received them before, but there is something about that letter, Hastings, that I do not like...'
sentences.translation: أنا أيضاً تلقيت مثلها من قبل، لكن هناك شيء في تلك الرسالة يا هاستينغز لا يعجبني...

sentences.text: Poirot shook his head. Then he picked up the letter and put it in the desk.
sentences.translation: هز بوارو رأسه. ثم رفع الرسالة ووضعها في المكتب.

sentences.text: 'If you really think it's serious, can't you do something?' I asked.
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'As always, you are a man who wants action! But what can we do? The police have seen the letter but they, too, will do nothing. There are no fingerprints on it. There are no clues to the possible writer.'
'In fact, there is only your own feeling?'
'Not feeling, Hastings. Feeling is a bad word. It is my knowledge - my experience - that tells me something about that letter is wrong.'
He waved his hands about, then shook his head again.
sentences.translation: لوّح بيديه، ثم هز رأسه مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: 'Well,' I said, 'the 21st is Friday. If a big robbery happens near Andover then -'
sentences.translation: قلت،

sentences.text: 'Ah, what a good thing that would be!'
'A good thing?' I stared in surprise. The word seemed to be a very strange one to use.
sentences.translation: حدقت بدهشة. بدت الكلمة غريبة جداً للاستخدام.

sentences.text: A robbery may be exciting, but surely it can't be a good thing!
sentences.translation: قد تكون السرقة مثيرة، لكن بالتأكيد لا يمكن أن تكون شيئاً جيداً!

sentences.text: Poirot shook his head. 'You don't understand, my friend. It would be a good thing because it would clear my mind of the fear of something else.'
sentences.translation: هز بوارو رأسه.

sentences.text: 'Of what?'
'Murder,' said Hercule Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال هرقل بوارو.

sentences.text: Mr Alexander Bonaparte Cust got up from his chair and looked near-sightedly round his bedroom.
sentences.translation: نهض السيد ألكسندر بونابرت كاست من كرسيه ونظر حول غرفة نومه بقصر نظر.

sentences.text: The furniture was old and the bedroom was not very clean.
sentences.translation: كان الأثاث قديماً وغرفة النوم لم تكن نظيفة جداً.

sentences.text: His back hurt from sitting in the same position far too long.
sentences.translation: كان ظهره يؤلمه من الجلوس في نفس الوضع لفترة طويلة جداً.

sentences.text: As stretched himself to his full height, you could see that he was quite a tall man, but he did not look tall because he stooped.
sentences.translation: عندما مد نفسه إلى طوله الكامل، كان بإمكانك أن ترى أنه كان رجلاً طويلاً جداً، لكنه لم يبد طويلاً لأنه كان منحنياً.

sentences.text: He went to a coat that was hanging on the back of the door, and took from the pocket a packet of cheap cigarettes and some matches.
sentences.translation: ذهب إلى معطف كان معلقاً على ظهر الباب، وأخرج من الجيب علبة سجائر رخيصة وبعض أعواد الثقاب.

sentences.text: He lit a cigarette and then returned to the table.
sentences.translation: أشعل سيجارة ثم عاد إلى الطاولة.

sentences.text: He picked up a railway guide and searched for some information inside it.
sentences.translation: رفع دليل سكك حديدية وبحث عن بعض المعلومات بداخله.

sentences.text: Then he looked at a typewritten list of names.
sentences.translation: ثم نظر إلى قائمة أسماء مطبوعة على الآلة الكاتبة.

sentences.text: With a pen, he made a mark against one of the first names on the list.
sentences.translation: بقلم، وضع علامة أمام أحد الأسماء الأولى في القائمة.

sentences.text: It was Thursday, 30 June.
sentences.translation: كان يوم الخميس، 30 يونيو.

sentences.text: I had forgotten about the anonymous letter which Poirot had received, and the importance of the 21st.
sentences.translation: كنت قد نسيت الرسالة المجهولة التي تلقاها بوارو، وأهمية الحادي والعشرين.

sentences.text: On the 22nd, Poirot received a visit from Chief Inspector Japp of Scotland Yard.
sentences.translation: في الثاني والعشرين، تلقى بوارو زيارة من المفتش الرئيسي جاب من سكوتلاند يارد.

sentences.text: We had known the Inspector for many years, and he welcomed me warmly.
sentences.translation: كنا نعرف المفتش منذ سنوات عديدة، ورحب بي بحرارة.

sentences.text: 'What a surprise!' he cried. 'It's just like the old days, seeing you with Monsieur Poirot again.'
sentences.translation: صرخ.

sentences.text: You're looking well, too. Your hair is just getting a little thin. Well, that's what happens to all of us.'
sentences.translation: تبدو بحالة جيدة أيضاً. شعرك أصبح خفيفاً قليلاً فقط. حسناً، هذا ما يحدث لنا جميعاً.

sentences.text: I always brushed my hair carefully across the top of my head, so I wasn't very pleased that Inspector Japp had noticed my thinning hair.
sentences.translation: كنت دائماً أمشط شعري بعناية عبر الجزء العلوي من رأسي، لذلك لم أكن سعيداً جداً لأن المفتش جاب لاحظ ترقق شعري.

sentences.text: But I decided not to get upset.
sentences.translation: لكنني قررت ألا أنزعج.

sentences.text: 'Yes, we're all getting older,' I agreed.
sentences.translation: وافقت.

sentences.text: 'Except for Monsieur Poirot,' said Japp, smiling at my friend.
sentences.translation: قال جاب، مبتسماً لصديقي.

sentences.text: 'His hair and moustache look wonderful. And since he retired, he's become very famous.'
Train mysteries, air mysteries, high society deaths - oh, he's here, there and everywhere.
sentences.translation: ألغاز القطارات، ألغاز الجو، وفيات المجتمع الراقي - أوه، إنه هنا وهناك وفي كل مكان.

sentences.text: Have you heard about his anonymous letter?'
sentences.translation: هل سمعت عن رسالته المجهولة؟

sentences.text: 'I showed it to Hastings the other day,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Of course,' I said. 'I'd completely forgotten about it. What was the date in the letter?'
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'Yesterday,' said Japp. 'That's why I've come here.'
sentences.translation: قال جاب.

sentences.text: I rang the police in Andover to see it anything had happened.
sentences.translation: اتصلت بالشرطة في أندوفر لأرى إن كان قد حدث أي شيء.

sentences.text: But the letter is certainly a joke.
sentences.translation: لكن الرسالة بالتأكيد مزحة.

sentences.text: A shop window was broken by children throwing stones, and a few people got drunk, but that's all.'
sentences.translation: كسر children نافذة متجر برمي الحجارة، وسكر بعض الناس، لكن هذا كل شيء.

sentences.text: 'I am very glad about that,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'We get lots of letters like that every day,' said Japp, 'from people who have nothing better to do. They don't mean any harm. They're just looking for a bit of excitement.'
sentences.translation: قال جاب،

sentences.text: 'I have been foolish to think that the matter was so serious,' Poirot agreed.
sentences.translation: وافق بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Well, I must go,' said Japp, laughing. 'I just wanted to stop you worrying.'
sentences.translation: قال جاب، ضاحكاً.

sentences.text: After the Inspector had left, Poirot said, 'He does not change much, the good Japp, eh?'
sentences.translation: بعد أن غادر المفتش، قال بوارو:

sentences.text: 'He looks much older,' I said. And his hair is going grey,' I added nastily.
sentences.translation: قلت.
أضفت بخبث.

sentences.text: 'You know, Hastings, I have a very clever hairdresser,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'He could put some false hair onto your head and brush your own hair over it -'
'Poirot!' I shouted. 'I'm not interested in your hairdresser. What's the matter with the top of my head?'
sentences.translation: صرخت.

sentences.text: 'Nothing - nothing at all,' said Poirot quickly.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو بسرعة.

sentences.text: 'Well,' I said, feeling a little calmer. 'I'm sorry that that anonymous letter didn't lead to an interesting crime.'
sentences.translation: قلت، وأنا أشعر بقليل من الهدوء.

sentences.text: 'Yes, I was wrong about that,' said Poirot. 'I am too suspicious.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: CHAPTER TWO
sentences.translation: الفصل الثاني

sentences.text: A Visit to Andover
sentences.translation: زيارة إلى أندوفر

sentences.text: We were met at Andover by Inspector Glen, a tall, fair-haired man with a pleasant smile.
sentences.translation: استقبلنا في أندوفر المفتش غلين، رجل طويل ذو شعر أشقر وابتسامة لطيفة.

sentences.text: He gave us the facts about the case.
sentences.translation: أعطانا الحقائق حول القضية.

sentences.text: 'The crime was discovered by Police Constable Dover at 1.00 am on the morning of the 22nd.'
sentences.translation: "اكتشف الجريمة الشرطي دوفر في الساعة الواحدة صباحاً من صباح يوم الثاني والعشرين."

sentences.text: He noticed that the door of the shop wasn't locked.
sentences.translation: لاحظ أن باب المتجر لم يكن مغلقاً.

sentences.text: He entered, and at first he thought that the place was empty.
sentences.translation: دخل، وفي البداية اعتقد أن المكان فارغ.

sentences.text: But when he shone a light over the counter, he saw the body of the old woman.
sentences.translation: لكن عندما سلط الضوء على المنضدة، رأى جثة المرأة العجوز.

sentences.text: 'When the police doctor arrived, it was found that the woman had been hit hard on the back of the head.'
sentences.translation: "عندما وصل طبيب الشرطة، وُجد أن المرأة قد ضُربت بقوة على مؤخرة رأسها."

sentences.text: The doctor said that she had probably died about seven to nine hours earlier.
sentences.translation: قال الطبيب إنها ربما ماتت منذ حوالي سبع إلى تسع ساعات.

sentences.text: 'But we've found a man who went in and bought some tobacco at 5:30,' said Inspector Glen.
sentences.translation: "لكننا وجدنا رجلاً دخل واشترى بعض التبغ في الساعة الخامسة والنصف،" قال المفتش غلين.

sentences.text: 'And a second man went in and found the shop empty at five minutes past six.'
sentences.translation: "ودخل رجل ثانٍ ووجد المتجر فارغاً في الساعة السادسة وخمس دقائق."

sentences.text: So that puts the time of death at between 5.30 and 6.05.
sentences.translation: لذا فإن ذلك يضع وقت الوفاة بين الخامسة والنصف والسادسة وخمس دقائق.

sentences.text: 'We haven't been able to find anyone yet who saw Ascher, the woman's husband, near the shop at the time.'
sentences.translation: "لم نتمكن حتى الآن من العثور على أي شخص رأى آشر، زوج المرأة، بالقرب من المتجر في ذلك الوقت."

sentences.text: But he was in a pub at nine o'clock and was very drunk.
sentences.translation: لكنه كان في حانة في الساعة التاسعة وكان ثملاً جداً.

sentences.text: He's not a very pleasant kind of man.
sentences.translation: إنه ليس رجلاً لطيفاً جداً.

sentences.text: 'He didn't live with his wife?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: "ألم يكن يعيش مع زوجته؟" سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'They separated some years ago. Ascher's German.'
sentences.translation: "انفصلا منذ بضع سنوات. آشر ألماني."

sentences.text: He was a waiter at one time, but he started drinking.
sentences.translation: كان نادلاً في وقت ما، لكنه بدأ يشرب.

sentences.text: After that, nobody wanted to employ him.
sentences.translation: بعد ذلك، لم يرغب أحد في توظيفه.

sentences.text: His wife worked as a cook-housekeeper to an old lady.
sentences.translation: عملت زوجته كطباخة ومدبرة منزل لسيدة عجوز.

sentences.text: When the woman died, she left Mrs Ascher some money and Mrs Ascher started this tobacco and newspaper business.
sentences.translation: عندما ماتت السيدة، تركت للسيدة آشر بعض المال، فبدأت السيدة آشر تجارة التبغ والصحف هذه.

sentences.text: Ascher used to come round and cause problems for her, so she gave him a small amount of money every week to make him go away.
sentences.translation: كان آشر يأتي ويثير المشاكل لها، فكانت تعطيه مبلغاً صغيراً من المال كل أسبوع ليجعله يذهب بعيداً.

sentences.text: 'Had they any children?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: "هل كان لديهما أي أطفال؟" سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'No. There's a niece. She's working as a maid near Overton.'
sentences.translation: "لا. هناك ابنة أخت. إنها تعمل كخادمة بالقرب من أوفرتون."

sentences.text: 'And you say that this man Ascher used to threaten his wife?'
sentences.translation: "وتقول إن هذا الرجل آشر كان يهدد زوجته؟"

sentences.text: 'That's right. He was terrible when he was drunk - threatening to kill her.'
sentences.translation: "هذا صحيح. كان فظيعاً عندما كان ثملاً - يهدد بقتلها."

sentences.text: 'Was anything missing from the shop?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: "هل كان هناك أي شيء مفقود من المتجر؟" سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Nothing. No money was taken. No signs of robber.'
sentences.translation: "لا شيء. لم يُؤخذ أي مال. لا توجد علامات سطو."

sentences.text: 'You think that this man Ascher came into the shop drunk, started threatening his wife and finally struck her down?'
sentences.translation: "هل تعتقد أن هذا الرجل آشر دخل المتجر ثملاً، وبدأ يهدد زوجته وأخيراً ضربها حتى الموت؟"

sentences.text: 'It seems the most likely solution,' said the Inspector.
sentences.translation: "يبدو هذا الحل الأكثر ترجيحاً،" قال المفتش.

sentences.text: 'But I'd like to have another look at that letter you received. I was wondering if Ascher wrote it.'
sentences.translation: "لكنني أود إلقاء نظرة أخرى على تلك الرسالة التي تلقيتها. كنت أتساءل إن كان آشر قد كتبها."

sentences.text: Poirot handed over the letter and the Inspector read it.
sentences.translation: سلم بوارو الرسالة وقرأها المفتش.

sentences.text: 'I don't think it's from Ascher,' he said at last.
sentences.translation: "لا أعتقد أنها من آشر،" قال أخيراً.

sentences.text: 'I don't think that he would use the words "our" British police. It's good quality paper, too.'
sentences.translation: "لا أعتقد أنه سيستخدم كلمات "شرطتنا" البريطانية. الورق أيضاً عالي الجودة."

sentences.text: It's strange that the letter should say the 21st of the month. Of course it might be coincidence.'
sentences.translation: من الغريب أن تقول الرسالة الحادي والعشرين من الشهر. بالطبع قد تكون مصادفة."

sentences.text: 'That is possible - yes,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: "هذا ممكن - نعم،" قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'But I don't like this kind of coincidence, Mr Poirot. ABC. Who could ABC be? We'll see if Mary Drawer - that's Mrs Ascher's niece - can give us any help. It's a strange business.'
sentences.translation: "لكني لا أحب هذا النوع من المصادفات، سيد بوارو. ABC. من يمكن أن يكون ABC؟ سنرى إن كانت ماري دراور - وهي ابنة أخت السيدة آشر - يمكنها مساعدتنا. إنها قضية غريبة."

sentences.text: A constable came in. 'Yes, Briggs, what is it?'
sentences.translation: دخل شرطي. "نعم، بريغز، ما الأمر؟"

sentences.text: 'It's the man Ascher, sir. We've found him.'
sentences.translation: "إنه الرجل آشر يا سيدي. لقد وجدناه."

sentences.text: 'Right. Bring him in here. Where was he?'
sentences.translation: "حسناً. أحضره إلى هنا. أين كان؟"

sentences.text: 'Hiding down by the railway.'
sentences.translation: "يختبئ بالأسفل عند السكة الحديدية."

sentences.text: Franz Ascher was a very unattractive man.
sentences.translation: كان فرانز آشر رجلاً غير جذاب على الإطلاق.

sentences.text: He was crying and threatening us at the same time.
sentences.translation: كان يبكي ويهددنا في نفس الوقت.

sentences.text: He looked at each of our faces in turn.
sentences.translation: نظر إلى كل واحد من وجوهنا بدوره.

sentences.text: 'What do you want with me? You should be ashamed to bring me here! You are pigs! How dare you do this?'
sentences.translation: "ماذا تريدون مني؟ يجب أن تخجلوا من إحضاري إلى هنا! أنتم خنازير! كيف تجرؤون على فعل هذا؟"

sentences.text: His voice changed suddenly. 'No, no, I do not mean that - you would not hurt a poor old man - not be hard on him.'
sentences.translation: تغير صوته فجأة. "لا، لا، لا أقصد ذلك - لن تؤذوا رجلاً عجوزاً مسكيناً - لا تكونوا قساة عليه."

sentences.text: Everyone is hard on poor old Franz. Poor old Franz.'
sentences.translation: الجميع قساة على فرانز العجوز المسكين. فرانز العجوز المسكين."

sentences.text: Mr Ascher started to cry.
sentences.translation: بدأ السيد آشر في البكاء.

sentences.text: 'Stop that, Ascher,' said the Inspector. 'Control yourself. You're not in any trouble yet. If you didn't kill your wife...'
sentences.translation: "توقف عن ذلك يا آشر،" قال المفتش. "تحكم في نفسك. أنت لست في مشكلة بعد. إذا لم تقتل زوجتك..."

sentences.text: Ascher interrupted him, his voice almost a scream.
sentences.translation: قاطعه آشر، وكان صوته أشبه بصرخة.

sentences.text: 'I did not kill her! I did not kill her! It is all lies! You are English pigs - all against me.'
sentences.translation: "لم أقتلها! لم أقتلها! كلها أكاذيب! أنتم خنازير إنجليز - كلكم ضدي."

sentences.text: I would never kill her - never.
sentences.translation: لن أقتلها أبداً - أبداً.

sentences.text: 'You often threatened to kill her, Ascher.'
sentences.translation: "كنت غالباً ما تهدد بقتلها يا آشر."

sentences.text: 'No. You do not understand. That was just a joke between Alice and me.'
sentences.translation: "لا. أنتم لا تفهمون. كانت مجرد مزحة بين أليس وأنا."

sentences.text: 'A strange kind of joke! Where were you yesterday evening, Ascher?'
sentences.translation: "نوع غريب من المزاح! أين كنت مساء أمس يا آشر؟"

sentences.text: 'I did not go near Alice. I was with friends - good friends.'
sentences.translation: "لم أقترب من أليس. كنت مع أصدقاء - أصدقاء طيبين."

sentences.text: We were drinking at the Seven Stars - and then at the Red Dog.
sentences.translation: كنا نشرب في سيڤن ستارز - ثم في ريد دوغ.

sentences.text: Dick Willows - he was with me - and old Curdie - and George - and Piatt.
sentences.translation: ديك ويلوز - كان معي - وكوردي العجوز - وجورج - وبيات.

sentences.text: It is the truth that I am telling you!'
sentences.translation: إنها الحقيقة التي أخبركم بها!"

sentences.text: 'Take him away,' Inspector Glen said to Constable Briggs.
sentences.translation: "خذه بعيداً،" قال المفتش غلين للشرطي بريغز.

sentences.text: 'Hold him on suspicion of murder. I don't know what to think,' he said as the unpleasant, shaking old man was taken out.
sentences.translation: "احتجزه للاشتباه في القتل. لا أعرف ماذا أعتقد،" قال بينما كان الرجل العجوز غير اللطيف المرتجف يُقتاد خارجاً.

sentences.text: 'If the letter didn't exist, I'd say he did it.'
sentences.translation: "لو لم توجد الرسالة، لكنت سأقول إنه فعلها."

sentences.text: 'What about the men he talked about?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: "ماذا عن الرجال الذين تحدث عنهم؟" سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'A bad crowd - all ready to tell lies. But it's important to find out whether anyone saw him near the shop between half past five and six.'
sentences.translation: "جماعة سيئة - كلهم مستعدون لقول الأكاذيب. لكن من المهم معرفة ما إذا رآه أحد بالقرب من المتجر بين الخامسة والنصف والسادسة."

sentences.text: Poirot shook his head thoughtfully.
sentences.translation: هز بوارو رأسه متأملاً.

sentences.text: 'You are sure nothing was taken from the shop?' he asked.
sentences.translation: "هل أنت متأكد أنه لم يُؤخذ شيء من المتجر؟" سأل.

sentences.text: 'Perhaps a packet or two of cigarettes. But that not a reason for murder.'
sentences.translation: "ربما علبة أو علبتين من السجائر. لكن هذا ليس سبباً للقتل."

sentences.text: 'And there was nothing different about the shop? Nothing new there?'
sentences.translation: "ولم يكن هناك شيء مختلف في المتجر؟ لا شيء جديد هناك؟"

sentences.text: 'There was a railway guide,' said the Inspector.
sentences.translation: "كان هناك دليل سكك حديدية،" قال المفتش.

sentences.text: 'It was open and turned face down on the counter. It appeared that someone had looked up the trains from Andover.'
sentences.translation: "كان مفتوحاً وموضوعاً ووجهه لأسفل على المنضدة. بدا أن أحدهم بحث عن القطارات من أندوفر."

sentences.text: Either the old woman or a customer.
sentences.translation: إما المرأة العجوز أو أحد العملاء.

sentences.text: 'Did she sell that type of thing?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: "هل كانت تبيع هذا النوع من الأشياء؟" سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: The Inspector shook his head.
sentences.translation: هز المفتش رأسه.

sentences.text: 'She sold cheap timetables. This was a big one - the kind of guide that only a big shop would sell.'
sentences.translation: "كانت تبيع جداول مواعيد رخيصة. هذا كان كبيراً - نوع الدليل الذي لا يبيعه إلا متجر كبير."

sentences.text: A light came into Poirot eyes.
sentences.translation: ظهر بريق في عيني بوارو.

sentences.text: He bent forward.
sentences.translation: انحنى إلى الأمام.

sentences.text: 'A railway guide, you say. What kind? Was it an ABC?'
sentences.translation: "دليل سكك حديدية، كما تقول. أي نوع؟ هل كان ABC؟"

sentences.text: 'Yes,' said the Inspector. It was an ABC.'
sentences.translation: "نعم،" قال المفتش. "كان ABC."

sentences.text: Until that moment, I had not felt very interested in the case.
sentences.translation: حتى تلك اللحظة، لم أشعر باهتمام كبير بالقضية.

sentences.text: The murder of an old woman in a small back-street shop was a very ordinary type of crime.
sentences.translation: كان قتل امرأة عجوز في متجر صغير في شارع خلفي نوعاً عادياً جداً من الجرائم.

sentences.text: I had thought that the date of the 21st in the anonymous letter was just a coincidence.
sentences.translation: كنت أعتقد أن تاريخ الحادي والعشرين في الرسالة المجهولة كان مجرد مصادفة.

sentences.text: Mrs Ascher, I felt sure, had been murdered by her husband.
sentences.translation: شعرت باليقين أن السيدة آشر قد قتلها زوجها.

sentences.text: But now, when I heard about the railway guide, I felt a small shock of excitement.
sentences.translation: لكن الآن، عندما سمعت عن دليل السكك الحديدية، شعرت بصدمة صغيرة من الإثارة.

sentences.text: Surely - surely this could not be a second coincidence.
sentences.translation: بالتأكيد - بالتأكيد لا يمكن أن تكون هذه مصادفة ثانية.

sentences.text: The ordinary crime was turning into something very unusual.
sentences.translation: كانت الجريمة العادية تتحول إلى شيء غير عادي جداً.

sentences.text: We left the police station and went to the building where the body of the dead woman was being kept.
sentences.translation: غادرنا مركز الشرطة وذهبنا إلى المبنى حيث كانت جثة المرأة الميتة محفوظة.

sentences.text: A strange feeling came over me as I looked down on that old face and thin grey hair.
sentences.translation: غمرني شعور غريب وأنا أنظر إلى ذلك الوجه العجوز والشعر الرمادي الرقيق.

sentences.text: She looked so peaceful, so distanced from any violent event.
sentences.translation: بدت مسالمة جداً، بعيدة جداً عن أي حدث عنيف.

sentences.text: 'She was beautiful when she was young,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: "كانت جميلة عندما كانت شابة،" قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Really?' I said.
sentences.translation: "حقاً؟" قلت.

sentences.text: 'But yes, look at the lines of the bones, the shape of the head.'
sentences.translation: "لكن نعم، انظر إلى خطوط العظام، وشكل الرأس."

sentences.text: We went to see the police doctor, Dr Kerr.
sentences.translation: ذهبنا لرؤية طبيب الشرطة، الدكتور كير.

sentences.text: 'We haven't found what killed her,' he said. 'It's impossible to say what it was - perhaps a heavy stick.'
sentences.translation: "لم نجد ما قتلها،" قال. "من المستحيل تحديد ما كان - ربما عصا ثقيلة."

sentences.text: 'Did the murderer have to be very strong?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: "هل كان يجب أن يكون القاتل قوياً جداً؟" سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Do you mean, could the killer be a shaky old man of seventy?'
sentences.translation: "هل تقصد، هل يمكن أن يكون القاتل رجلاً عجوزاً مرتجفاً في السبعين؟"

sentences.text: Oh, yes, it's possible - if there was enough weight in the head of the stick.'
sentences.translation: أوه، نعم، هذا ممكن - إذا كان هناك ثقل كافٍ في رأس العصا."

sentences.text: 'Then the murderer could be a man or a woman?'
sentences.translation: "إذن يمكن أن يكون القاتل رجلاً أو امرأة؟"

sentences.text: The doctor looked surprised.
sentences.translation: بدا الطبيب مندهشاً.

sentences.text: 'A woman, eh? I hadn't thought of connecting a woman with this type of crime. But of course it's possible'
sentences.translation: "امرأة، أها؟ لم أفكر في ربط امرأة بهذا النوع من الجرائم. لكن بالطبع هذا ممكن."

sentences.text: Poirot nodded in agreement. 'How was the body lying?' he asked.
sentences.translation: أومأ بوارو موافقاً. "كيف كانت الجثة مستلقية؟" سأل.

sentences.text: 'In my opinion, Mrs Ascher was standing with her back to the counter.'
sentences.translation: "في رأيي، كانت السيدة آشر واقفة وظهرها إلى المنضدة."

sentences.text: The murderer hit her on the back of the head and she fell down behind the counter.
sentences.translation: ضربها القاتل على مؤخرة رأسها فسقطت خلف المنضدة.

sentences.text: So she couldn't be seen by anybody entering the shop.
sentences.translation: لذلك لم يكن بإمكان أي شخص يدخل المتجر رؤيتها.

sentences.text: We thanked Dr Kerr and left.
sentences.translation: شكرنا الدكتور كير وغادرنا.

sentences.text: 'You see, Hastings,' said Poirot, 'this shows that Ascher may be innocent.'
sentences.translation: "أترى يا هاستينغز،" قال بوارو، "هذا يظهر أن آشر قد يكون بريئاً."

sentences.text: A woman faces a man who is threatening her.
sentences.translation: المرأة تواجه رجلاً يهددها.

sentences.text: But instead, she had her back to the murderer.
sentences.translation: لكن بدلاً من ذلك، كان ظهرها إلى القاتل.

sentences.text: So clearly she was taking down tobacco or cigarettes for a customer.'
sentences.translation: لذا من الواضح أنها كانت تُنزل تبغاً أو سجائر لعميل."

sentences.text: Poirot looked at his watch. 'Overton is not far away. Shall we drive over there and have an interview with the niece of the dead woman?'
sentences.translation: نظر بوارو إلى ساعته. "أوفرتون ليست بعيدة. هل نقود إلى هناك ونجري مقابلة مع ابنة أخت المرأة الميتة؟"

sentences.text: A few minutes later we were driving towards Overton.
sentences.translation: بعد بضع دقائق كنا نقود نحو أوفرتون.

sentences.text: Inspector Glen had given us the address of Mrs Ascher's niece.
sentences.translation: كان المفتش غلين قد أعطانا عنوان ابنة أخت السيدة آشر.

sentences.text: It was a big house about one and a half kilometres from the village, on the London side.
sentences.translation: كان منزلاً كبيراً على بعد حوالي كيلومتر ونصف من القرية، على الجانب المؤدي إلى لندن.

sentences.text: The door was opened by a pretty dark-haired girl. Her eyes were red from crying.
sentences.translation: فتحت الباب فتاة جميلة ذات شعر داكن. كانت عيناها حمراء من البكاء.

sentences.text: 'I think you are Mrs Mary Drawer, the maid here.' asked Poirot gently.
sentences.translation: "أعتقد أنك السيدة ماري دراور، الخادمة هنا." سأل بوارو بلطف.

sentences.text: 'Yes, sir, that's right. I'm Mary, sir.'
sentences.translation: "نعم يا سيدي، هذا صحيح. أنا ماري يا سيدي."

sentences.text: 'Then perhaps I can talk to you for a few minutes. It's about your aunt.'
sentences.translation: "إذن ربما يمكنني التحدث معك لبضع دقائق. إنه بشأن عمتك."

sentences.text: We went inside the house and Mary opened the door of a small living-room.
sentences.translation: دخلنا المنزل وفتحت ماري باب غرفة معيشة صغيرة.

sentences.text: We entered and Poirot sat down on a chair by the window.
sentences.translation: دخلنا وجلس بوارو على كرسي بجانب النافذة.

sentences.text: He looked up into the girl face, studying it closely.
sentences.translation: نظر إلى وجه الفتاة، ودرسه عن كثب.

sentences.text: 'You have heard of your aunt's death, of course?'
sentences.translation: "لقد سمعت عن وفاة عمتك، بالطبع؟"

sentences.text: The girl nodded, tears filling her eyes again.
sentences.translation: أومأت الفتاة، وامتلأت عيناها بالدموع مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: 'This morning, sir. The police came here. Oh! it's terrible! Poor Auntie!'
sentences.translation: "هذا الصباح يا سيدي. جاءت الشرطة إلى هنا. أوه! إنه أمر فظيع! عمتي المسكينة!"

sentences.text: 'You were fond of your aunt, Mary?' said Poirot gently.
sentences.translation: "كنت مغرمة بعمتك يا ماري؟" قال بوارو بلطف.

sentences.text: 'Very, sir. She was always very good to me. I usually visited Auntie on my free day. She had a lot of trouble with her husband.'
sentences.translation: "جداً يا سيدي. كانت دائماً لطيفة جداً معي. كنت عادة أزور عمتي في يوم إجازتي. كان لديها الكثير من المتاعب مع زوجها."

sentences.text: 'Tell me, Mary, did he threaten her?'
sentences.translation: "أخبريني يا ماري، هل كان يهددها؟"

sentences.text: 'Oh yes, sir. He used to say he would cut her throat, and things like that.'
sentences.translation: "أوه نعم يا سيدي. كان يقول إنه سيقطع حلقها، وأشياء من هذا القبيل."

sentences.text: 'So you were not very surprised when you learned what had happened?'
sentences.translation: "إذن لم تكوني مندهشة جداً عندما علمت بما حدث؟"

sentences.text: 'Oh, but I was,' Mary replied. 'You see, sir, I never thought that he meant it. And Auntie wasn't afraid of him. He was afraid of her.'
sentences.translation: "أوه، لكنني كنت كذلك،" ردت ماري. "أترى يا سيدي، لم أعتقد أبداً أنه يعني ذلك. وعمتي لم تكن خائفة منه. كان هو خائفاً منها."

sentences.text: 'Ah,' said Poirot. 'So, supposing someone else killed her... Have you any idea who that person could be?'
sentences.translation: "آه،" قال بوارو. "إذن، بافتراض أن شخصاً آخر قتلها... هل لديك أي فكرة من يمكن أن يكون ذلك الشخص؟"

sentences.text: 'I've no idea, sir,' said Mary in great surprise. 'It doesn't seem likely.'
sentences.translation: "ليس لدي أي فكرة يا سيدي،" قالت ماري بدهشة كبيرة. "لا يبدو ذلك محتملاً."

sentences.text: 'There was no one that your aunt was afraid of?'
sentences.translation: "لم يكن هناك أحد تخشاه عمتك؟"

sentences.text: Mary shook her head. 'Auntie wasn't afraid of people.'
sentences.translation: هزت ماري رأسها. "عمتي لم تكن تخاف من الناس."

sentences.text: 'Did she ever get anonymous letters? Letters that weren't signed - or were only signed with letters like ABC?'
sentences.translation: "هل تلقت يوماً رسائل مجهولة؟ رسائل غير موقعة - أو موقعة فقط بحروف مثل ABC؟"

sentences.text: Mary shook her head in surprise.
sentences.translation: هزت ماري رأسها بدهشة.

sentences.text: Poirot got up. 'If I want you at any time, Mary, I will write to you here.'
sentences.translation: نهض بوارو. "إذا احتجتك في أي وقت يا ماري، سأكتب إليك هنا."

sentences.text: 'Actually, sir, I'm going to leave this job. I don't like the country. I stayed here to be near my aunt.'
sentences.translation: "في الواقع يا سيدي، سأترك هذه الوظيفة. لا أحب الريف. بقيت هنا لأكون قريبة من عمتي."

sentences.text: But now' - her eyes filled with tears again - 'there's no reason for me to stay, so I'll go back to London.'
sentences.translation: لكن الآن" - امتلأت عيناها بالدموع مرة أخرى - "لم يعد هناك سبب لبقائي، لذا سأعود إلى لندن."

sentences.text: 'When you do go to London, will you give me your address?' Poirot handed her his card.
sentences.translation: "عندما تذهبين إلى لندن، هل ستعطيني عنوانك؟" سلمها بوارو بطاقته.

sentences.text: Mary looked at the card in surprise. 'Then you're not - a policeman, sir?'
sentences.translation: نظرت ماري إلى البطاقة بدهشة. "إذن أنت لست - شرطياً يا سيدي؟"

sentences.text: 'I am a private detective.'
sentences.translation: "أنا محقق خاص."

sentences.text: She stood there looking at him for some moments in silence.
sentences.translation: وقفت هناك تنظر إليه لبعض لحظات في صمت.

sentences.text: 'Is there anything - strange happening, sir?'
sentences.translation: "هل هناك أي شيء - غريب يحدث يا سيدي؟"

sentences.text: 'Yes, my child,' replied Poirot. 'There is something strange happening. Later you may be able to help me.'
sentences.translation: "نعم يا طفلتي،" رد بوارو. "هناك شيء غريب يحدث. لاحقاً قد تكونين قادرة على مساعدتي."

sentences.text: 'I - I'll do anything, sir. It - it isn't right, sir, Auntie being killed.'
sentences.translation: "أنا - سأفعل أي شيء يا سيدي. إنه - إنه ليس صحيحاً يا سيدي، أن تُقتل عمتي."

sentences.text: It was a strange way to describe her aunt's death, but I felt full of pity.
sentences.translation: كانت طريقة غريبة لوصف وفاة عمتها، لكنني شعرت بامتلاء قلبي بالشفقة.

sentences.text: A few moments later we were driving back to Andover.
sentences.translation: بعد لحظات قليلة كنا نقود عائدين إلى أندوفر.

sentences.text: CHAPTER THREE
sentences.translation: الفصل الثالث

sentences.text: Questions and Answers
sentences.translation: أسئلة وأجوبة

sentences.text: The murder had taken place on a street which was a turning off the main street.
sentences.translation: حدثت الجريمة في شارع متفرع من الشارع الرئيسي.

sentences.text: Mrs Ascher's shop was about half-way down it on the right-hand side.
sentences.translation: كان متجر السيدة آشر يقع في منتصف الشارع تقريباً على الجانب الأيمن.

sentences.text: A large crowd of people was standing outside the shop.
sentences.translation: كان حشد كبير من الناس يقف خارج المتجر.

sentences.text: A young constable was trying to make the crowd move away.
sentences.translation: كان شرطي شاب يحاول إبعاد الحشد.

sentences.text: Poirot stopped at a little distance from them.
sentences.translation: توقف بوارو على مسافة قليلة منهم.

sentences.text: From there we could see the sign over the shop door.
sentences.translation: من هناك رأينا اللافتة فوق باب المتجر.

sentences.text: Poirot repeated it softly.
sentences.translation: رددها بوارو بهدوء.

sentences.text: 'A. Ascher. Come, let us go inside, Hastings.'
We made our way through the crowd.
sentences.translation: شققنا طريقنا عبر الحشد.

sentences.text: Poirot showed the young constable a letter from Inspector Glen, explaining who we were.
sentences.translation: أرى بوارو الشرطي الشاب رسالة من المفتش غلين تشرح من نحن.

sentences.text: He nodded, and unlocked the door to let us pass inside.
sentences.translation: فأومأ برأسه، وفتح الباب ليسمح لنا بالمرور إلى الداخل.

sentences.text: The shop was very dark.
sentences.translation: كان المتجر مظلماً جداً.

sentences.text: The constable found and switched on the electric light.
sentences.translation: وجد الشرطي المفتاح وأضاء النور الكهربائي.

sentences.text: There were a few cheap magazines lying about, and newspapers from the day before - all dusty.
sentences.translation: كانت هناك بعض المجلات الرخيصة ملقاة هنا وهناك، وصحف من اليوم السابق - كلها مغطاة بالغبار.

sentences.text: Behind the counter there were shelves reaching to the ceiling, packed with tobacco and packets of cigarettes.
sentences.translation: خلف المنضدة كانت هناك أرفف تصل إلى السقف، مكتظة بالتبغ وعلب السجائر.

sentences.text: There were also jars of sweets.
sentences.translation: كانت هناك أيضاً برطمانات من الحلوى.

sentences.text: It was an ordinary little shop, like thousands of others.
sentences.translation: كان متجراً صغيراً عادياً، مثل الآلاف غيره.

sentences.text: 'She was down behind the counter,' the constable explained in a slow voice.
sentences.translation: شرح الشرطي بصوت بطيء.

sentences.text: 'The doctor says she never knew what hit her. She was probably reaching up to one of the shelves.'
'There was nothing in her hand?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'No, sir, but there was a packet of cigarettes down beside her.'
Poirot nodded. His eyes moved round the small shop, noting everything.
sentences.translation: أومأ بوارو. تحركت عيناه حول المتجر الصغير، تلاحظان كل شيء.

sentences.text: 'And the railway guide was - where?'
'Here, sir.'
The constable pointed out the place on the counter.
sentences.translation: أشار الشرطي إلى المكان على المنضدة.

sentences.text: 'It was open at the right page for Andover and lying face down.'
'Were there any fingerprints?' I asked.
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'There were none on the railway guide, sir. There were lots on the counter itself.'
'Were there any of Ascher's among them?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Too soon to say, sir.'
Poirot nodded again, then asked if the dead woman lived over the shop.
sentences.translation: أومأ بوارو مرة أخرى، ثم سأل إذا كانت المرأة الميتة تعيش فوق المتجر.

sentences.text: 'Yes, sir, you go through that door at the back, sir.'
Poirot passed through the door and I followed him.
sentences.translation: مر بوارو عبر الباب وتبعته.

sentences.text: Behind the shop there was a small room which was both a kitchen and living-room.
sentences.translation: خلف المتجر كانت هناك غرفة صغيرة كانت بمثابة مطبخ وغرفة معيشة.

sentences.text: It was tidy and clean but without much furniture.
sentences.translation: كانت مرتبة ونظيفة ولكن بدون الكثير من الأثاث.

sentences.text: There were a few photographs on a shelf over the fire.
sentences.translation: كانت هناك بعض الصور على رف فوق المدفأة.

sentences.text: One was of Mary Drawer, Mrs Ascher's niece.
sentences.translation: واحدة كانت لماري دراور، ابنة أخت السيدة آشر.

sentences.text: Another was of a young couple in old-fashioned clothes.
sentences.translation: وأخرى كانت لزوجين شابين بملابس قديمة الطراز.

sentences.text: The girl looked beautiful and the young man was handsome.
sentences.translation: بدت الفتاة جميلة وكان الشاب وسيماً.

sentences.text: 'Probably a wedding picture,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: I looked closely at the couple in the photograph.
sentences.translation: نظرت عن كثب إلى الزوجين في الصورة.

sentences.text: It was almost impossible to recognise the well-dressed young man as Ascher.
sentences.translation: كان من المستحيل تقريباً التعرف على الشاب أنيق الملبس على أنه آشر.

sentences.text: Upstairs there were two more small rooms.
sentences.translation: في الطابق العلوي كانت هناك غرفتان صغيرتان أخريان.

sentences.text: One had been the dead woman's bedroom.
sentences.translation: إحداهما كانت غرفة نوم المرأة الميتة.

sentences.text: There were a couple of old blankets on the bed; a small pile of underwear in one drawer and cookery books in another; a magazine; a pair of shiny new stockings, and a few clothes hanging up.
sentences.translation: كانت هناك بطانيتان قديمتان على السرير؛ كومة صغيرة من الملابس الداخلية في أحد الأدراج وكتب طهي في درج آخر؛ مجلة؛ زوج من الجوارب الجديدة اللامعة، وبعض الملابس معلقة.

sentences.text: 'Come, Hastings,' said Poirot quietly. 'There is nothing for us here.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو بهدوء.

sentences.text: When we were out in the street again, Poirot crossed the road.
sentences.translation: عندما خرجنا إلى الشارع مرة أخرى، عبر بوارو الطريق.

sentences.text: Almost exactly opposite Mrs Ascher's shop, there was a shop selling fruit and vegetables.
sentences.translation: مقابل متجر السيدة آشر تماماً تقريباً، كان هناك متجر لبيع الفواكه والخضروات.

sentences.text: In a quiet voice, Poirot told me what I had to do.
sentences.translation: بصوت هادئ، أخبرني بوارو بما يجب أن أفعله.

sentences.text: Then he entered the shop. After waiting a minute or two, I followed him in.
sentences.translation: ثم دخل المتجر. بعد انتظار دقيقة أو دقيقتين، تبعته إلى الداخل.

sentences.text: He was buying some green beans. I chose some apples.
sentences.translation: كان يشتري بعض الفاصوليا الخضراء. اخترت بعض التفاح.

sentences.text: Poirot talked excitedly to the fat lady who was serving him.
sentences.translation: تحدث بوارو بحماس إلى السيدة السمينة التي كانت تخدمه.

sentences.text: 'It was just opposite you, was it not, that the murder happened? Perhaps you even saw the murderer go into the shop - a tall, fair man with a beard, was he not? A Russian, I have heard.'
'What's that?' The woman looked up in surprise. 'A Russian did it?'
sentences.translation: نظرت المرأة بدهشة.

sentences.text: 'Mais, oui. I thought perhaps you noticed him last night?'

'Well, I don't get much chance to look,' said the woman. 'The evening's our busy time and there are always a lot of people passing after they finish work. A tall fair man with a beard - no, I can't say I saw him.'
sentences.translation: قالت المرأة.

sentences.text: I interrupted the conversation as Poirot had told me to.
sentences.translation: قاطعت المحادثة كما أخبرني بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Excuse me, sir,' I said to Poirot. 'I think you have the wrong information. A short dark man, I was told.'
sentences.translation: قلت لبوارو.

sentences.text: A discussion started between the fat woman, her husband and a young assistant.
sentences.translation: بدأ نقاش بين المرأة السمينة وزوجها ومساعد شاب.

sentences.text: They had seen four short dark men, and the assistant had seen a tall fair one.
sentences.translation: لقد رأوا أربعة رجال قصار داكنين، ورأى المساعد رجلاً طويلاً أشقر.

sentences.text: Poirot and I left the shop with our beans and apples.
sentences.translation: غادرنا بوارو وأنا المتجر مع الفاصوليا والتفاح.

sentences.text: 'And why did you do that, Poirot?' I asked.
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'I wanted to find out if it was possible for a stranger to enter Mrs Ascher's shop without being noticed.'
'Couldn't you simply ask those people if they saw anyone?'
'No, mon ami. If I asked those people for information, they would not tell me anything. But when I made a statement, they started to talk. We now know that this time is a
- there are a lot of people on the streets. Our murderer chose his time well, Hastings.'
sentences.translation: وقت ذروة

sentences.text: We gave our beans and apples to a very surprised small boy in the street.
sentences.translation: أعطينا الفاصوليا والتفاح لصبي صغير مندهش جداً في الشارع.

sentences.text: Then Poirot paused and looked at the houses on each side of Mrs Ascher's house.
sentences.translation: ثم توقف بوارو ونظر إلى المنازل على جانبي منزل السيدة آشر.

sentences.text: One was a house with curtains that had been white but were now grey.
sentences.translation: أحدها كان منزلاً بستائر كانت بيضاء لكنها أصبحت رمادية الآن.

sentences.text: Poirot knocked at the door. It was opened by a very dirty child.
sentences.translation: طرق بوارو الباب. فتحه طفل متسخ جداً.

sentences.text: 'Good evening' said Poirot. 'Is your mother in?'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: The child stared at us for a long time. Then he shouted up the stairs. 'Mum, you're wanted.'
sentences.translation: حدق الطفل بنا لفترة طويلة. ثم صرخ في أعلى الدرج:

sentences.text: A sharp-faced woman came down the stairs.
sentences.translation: نزلت امرأة حادة الملامح الدرج.

sentences.text: 'You're wasting your time here -' she began, but Poirot interrupted her.
sentences.translation: بدأت، لكن بوارو قاطعها.

sentences.text: 'Good evening, madam,' he said. I am a newspaper reporter, working for the Evening Star. I would like to offer you five pounds for some information about your neighbour, Mrs Ascher.'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: As soon as Poirot talked about money, the woman became more pleasant.
sentences.translation: بمجرد أن تحدث بوارو عن المال، أصبحت المرأة أكثر لطفاً.

sentences.text: 'I'm sorry I spoke so crossly just now,' she said, 'but a lot of men come along and try to sell me things - cleaning products, stockings, bags and other silly things. They all seem to know my name, too - Mrs Fowler.'
sentences.translation: قالت،

sentences.text: 'Well, Mrs Fowler,' said Poirot, 'you only have to give me some information. Then I'll write a report of the interview.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو،

sentences.text: Mrs Fowler began to talk about Mrs Ascher. She had had a lot of trouble with Franz Ascher. Everyone knew that. But she hadn't been afraid of him.
sentences.translation: بدأت السيدة فاولر تتحدث عن السيدة آشر. لقد واجهت الكثير من المتاعب مع فرانز آشر. الجميع يعرف ذلك. لكنها لم تكن خائفة منه.

sentences.text: Had Mrs Ascher ever received any strange letters, Poirot asked - letters without a signature? Mrs Fowler didn't think so.
sentences.translation: هل تلقت السيدة آشر يوماً أي رسائل غريبة، سأل بوارو - رسائل بدون توقيع؟ لم تعتقد السيدة فاولر ذلك.

sentences.text: Had Mrs Fowler seen a railway guide - an ABC - in Mrs Ascher's home? Mrs Fowler replied that she hadn't.
sentences.translation: هل رأت السيدة فاولر دليل سكك حديدية - ABC - في منزل السيدة آشر؟ ردت السيدة فاولر بأنها لم ترَ.

sentences.text: Had anyone seen Ascher go into the shop the evening before? Again, Mrs Fowler said no.
sentences.translation: هل رأى أي شخص آشر يدخل المتجر في مساء اليوم السابق؟ مرة أخرى، قالت السيدة فاولر لا.

sentences.text: Poirot paid her the five pounds and we went out into the street again.
sentences.translation: دفع لها بوارو الخمسة جنيهات وخرجنا إلى الشارع مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: 'That was rather an expensive interview, Poirot,' I said. 'Do you think she knows more than she told us?'
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'My friend, we are in the strange position of not knowing what questions to ask,' replied Poirot. 'Mrs Fowler has told us all that she thinks she knows. In the future, that information may be useful for us.'
sentences.translation: رد بوارو.

sentences.text: I didn't understand what Poirot meant, but at that moment we met Inspector Glen. He was looking rather unhappy.
sentences.translation: لم أفهم ما قصده بوارو، لكن في تلك اللحظة التقينا بالمفتش غلين. كان يبدو غير سعيد نوعاً ما.

sentences.text: He had spent the afternoon trying to get a list of people who had been seen entering the tobacco shop.
sentences.translation: كان قد قضى فترة ما بعد الظهر في محاولة للحصول على قائمة بالأشخاص الذين شوهدوا يدخلون متجر التبغ.

sentences.text: 'And nobody has seen anyone?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Oh, yes, they have. Three tall men, four short men with black moustaches, two beards, three fat men - all strangers, and all looking like criminals!'
Poirot smiled. 'Does anyone say that they have seen the man Ascher?'
sentences.translation: ابتسم بوارو.

sentences.text: 'No, they don't. And that's another reason why he might be innocent. I've just told the Chief Constable that I think this is a job for Scotland Yard. I don't believe it's a local crime.'
Poirot said seriously, 'I agree with you.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو بجدية:

sentences.text: The Inspector said, 'You know, Monsieur Poirot, it's a nasty business - I don't like it...'
sentences.translation: قال المفتش:

sentences.text: We had two more interviews before returning to London.
sentences.translation: أجرينا مقابلتين أخريين قبل العودة إلى لندن.

sentences.text: The first was with Mr James Partridge, who had bought something from Mrs Ascher at 5.30.
sentences.translation: كانت الأولى مع السيد جيمس بارتريدج، الذي اشترى شيئاً من السيدة آشر في الساعة الخامسة والنصف.

sentences.text: Mr Partridge was a tidy little man. He worked in a bank and wore glasses on the end of his nose. He was very exact in everything he said.
sentences.translation: كان السيد بارتريدج رجلاً صغيراً مرتباً. كان يعمل في بنك ويرتدي نظارة على طرف أنفه. كان دقيقاً جداً في كل ما يقوله.

sentences.text: 'Mr - er - Poirot,' he said, looking at the card my friend had handed to him. 'From Inspector Glen? What can I do for you, Mr Poirot?'
sentences.translation: قال، وهو ينظر إلى البطاقة التي سلمها له صديقي.

sentences.text: 'I understand that you were the last person to see Mrs Ascher alive?'
Mr Partridge placed the ends of his fingers together and stared at Poirot.
sentences.translation: وضع السيد بارتريدج أطراف أصابعه معاً وحدق في بوارو.

sentences.text: 'That is not certain, Mr Poirot,' he said. 'It's possible that there were other customers after me.'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: 'If there were, they have not reported it' said Poirot. 'But you, I understand, went to the police without waiting to be asked?'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Certainly I did. As soon as I heard about the shocking event, I realised that my statement might be helpful.'
'You have an excellent sense of duty,' said Poirot. 'Perhaps you could kindly repeat your story to me.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Certainly. I was returning to this house and at 5.30 exactly I entered Mrs Ascher's shop. I often bought things there. It was on my way home.'
'Did you know that Mrs Ascher had a drunken husband who was in the habit of threatening her life?'
'No. I knew nothing about her.'
'Did you think there was anything unusual about her appearance yesterday evening? Did she seem different from usual?'
Mr Partridge thought for a time. 'She seemed exactly as usual,' he said at last.
sentences.translation: فكر السيد بارتريدج لبعض الوقت.
قال أخيراً.

sentences.text: Poirot got up. 'Thank you, Mr Partridge, for answering these questions. Have you an ABC in the house? I want to look up my return train to London.'
sentences.translation: نهض بوارو.

sentences.text: 'On the shelf behind you,' said Mr Partridge.
sentences.translation: قال السيد بارتريدج.

sentences.text: Poirot took down the ABC and pretended to look up a train. Then he thanked Mr Partridge and we left.
sentences.translation: أنزل بوارو دليل ABC وتظاهر بالبحث عن قطار. ثم شكر السيد بارتريدج وغادرنا.

sentences.text: Our next interview was with Mr Albert Riddell. Mr Riddell was an enormous man with a large face and small suspicious eyes.
sentences.translation: كانت مقابلتنا التالية مع السيد ألبرت ريدل. كان السيد ريدل رجلاً ضخماً ذا وجه كبير وعينين صغيرتين مشككتين.

sentences.text: He looked at us angrily. 'I've told everything once already,' he said. 'I've told the police, and now I've got to tell it again to two foreigners.'
sentences.translation: نظر إلينا بغضب.
قال.

sentences.text: Poirot gave me a quick, amused look, and then said, 'I am sorry, but it is a case of murder. One has to be very, very careful. You did not, I think, go to the police?'
sentences.translation: أعطاني بوارو نظرة سريعة مستمتعة، ثم قال:

sentences.text: 'Why should I? It wasn't my business. I've got my work to do.'
'People saw you going into the shop and gave your name to the police. But the police had to come to you first. Were they happy with your information?'
'Why shouldn't they be?' said Mr Riddell angrily. 'Everyone knows who killed the old woman - that husband of hers.'
sentences.translation: قال السيد ريدل بغضب.

sentences.text: 'But he was not in the street that evening and you were.'
'You're trying to say that I did it, are you? Well, you won't succeed. What reason did I have to do a thing like that?'
He got up from his chair in a threatening way.
sentences.translation: نهض من كرسيه بطريقة تهديدية.

sentences.text: 'Calm yourself, monsieur,' said Poirot. 'I only want you to tell me about your visit. It was six o'clock when you entered the shop?'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'That's right - a minute or two after six. I wanted a packet of tobacco. I pushed open the door and went in. There wasn't anyone there. I waited, but nobody came so I went out again.'
'You didn't see the body behind the counter?'
'No.'
'Was there a railway guide lying about?'
'Yes, there was - face down. I thought perhaps the old woman had to go somewhere by train and forgot to lock the shop.'
'Perhaps you picked up the railway guide and moved it along the counter?'
'I didn't touch it. I did just what I said,' said Mr Riddell angrily.
sentences.translation: قال السيد ريدل بغضب.

sentences.text: 'And you did not see anyone leaving the shop before you got there?'
'No. Why are you trying to fix this murder on me?'
Poirot got up. 'Nobody is fixing anything on you - yet. Bon soir, monsieur.'
sentences.translation: نهض بوارو.

sentences.text: Poirot went out into the street and I followed him. He looked at his watch. 'If we are quick, my friend, we might catch the 7.02 train to London.'
sentences.translation: خرج بوارو إلى الشارع وتبعته. نظر إلى ساعته.

sentences.text: I wasn't really listening to Poirot's next words. But later I remembered them very clearly.
sentences.translation: لم أكن أستمع حقاً لكلمات بوارو التالية. لكنني تذكرتها لاحقاً بوضوح شديد.

sentences.text: 'This is the beginning,' said Hercule Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال هرقل بوارو.

sentences.text: CHAPTER FOUR
sentences.translation: الفصل الرابع

sentences.text: The Second Letter
sentences.translation: الرسالة الثانية

sentences.text: 'Am I a magician? What do you want me to do? The police are doing everything they can. They will discover anything that can be discovered.'
In the days that followed, I found that Poirot was strangely unwilling to talk about the case.
sentences.translation: في الأيام التي تلت ذلك، وجدت أن بوارو كان غير راغب بشكل غريب في التحدث عن القضية.

sentences.text: In my own mind, I was afraid that I knew the reason why.
sentences.translation: في عقلي، كنت خائفاً من أنني أعرف السبب.

sentences.text: Poirot hadn't been able to solve the murder of Mrs Ascher.
sentences.translation: لم يكن بوارو قادراً على حل جريمة قتل السيدة آشر.

sentences.text: My friend was used to success and he found failure very difficult - so difficult that he didn't even want to talk about it.
sentences.translation: كان صديقي معتاداً على النجاح ووجد الفشل صعباً جداً - صعباً لدرجة أنه لم يرغب حتى في التحدث عنه.

sentences.text: The crime received very little attention in the newspapers.
sentences.translation: لم تحظ الجريمة باهتمام كبير في الصحف.

sentences.text: There was nothing exciting or unusual about the murder of an old woman.
sentences.translation: لم يكن هناك شيء مثير أو غير عادي في جريمة قتل امرأة عجوز.

sentences.text: The newspapers soon found more exciting subjects to write about.
sentences.translation: سرعان ما وجدت الصحف مواضيع أكثر إثارة للكتابة عنها.

sentences.text: I was beginning to forget about the matter when something new happened.
sentences.translation: بدأت أنسى الأمر عندما حدث شيء جديد.

sentences.text: I hadn't seen Poirot for a couple of days as I had been away for the weekend.
sentences.translation: لم أرَ بوارو لبضعة أيام لأنني كنت بعيداً في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

sentences.text: I arrived back on the Monday afternoon and the letter came by the six o'clock post.
sentences.translation: وصلت عائداً بعد ظهر يوم الاثنين وجاءت الرسالة مع بريد الساعة السادسة.

sentences.text: Poirot opened the envelope and breathed in deeply.
sentences.translation: فتح بوارو الظرف وتنفس بعمق.

sentences.text: 'It has come,' he said.
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: 'What has come?'
'The second part of the ABC business. Read it,' said Poirot, and passed me the letter.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو، ومرر لي الرسالة.

sentences.text: As before, it was typed on good quality paper.
sentences.translation: كما في السابق، كانت مطبوعة على ورق عالي الجودة.

sentences.text: Dear Mr Poirot, Well, I won the first part of the game, I think.
sentences.translation: عزيزي السيد بوارو، حسناً، لقد فزت بالجزء الأول من اللعبة، كما أعتقد.

sentences.text: The Andover business went very well, didn't it?
sentences.translation: سارت قضية أندوفر بشكل جيد جداً، أليس كذلك؟

sentences.text: But the fun's only just beginning. Watch what happens at Bexhill-on-Sea on the 25th of the month.
sentences.translation: لكن المرح قد بدأ للتو. راقب ما سيحدث في بيكسهيل-أون-سي في الخامس والعشرين من الشهر.

sentences.text: What a great time we are having!
sentences.translation: يا له من وقت رائع نقضيه!

sentences.text: Yours, ABC
sentences.translation: المخلص، ABC

sentences.text: 'Does this mean this man is going to try and murder someone else?' I said.
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'Naturally, Hastings. Did you think that the Andover business was going to be the only case? Do you not remember me saying,
sentences.translation: هذه هي البداية

sentences.text: 'But this is horrible! We're facing a mad killer.'
The next morning there was a meeting of some powerful police officials.
sentences.translation: في صباح اليوم التالي كان هناك اجتماع لبعض مسؤولي الشرطة الأقوياء.

sentences.text: There was the Chief Constable of Sussex, Inspector Glen from Andover, Superintendent Carter of the Sussex police, Inspector Japp, a younger inspector called Crome, and also Dr Thomson, the famous specialist in illnesses of the mind.
sentences.translation: كان هناك رئيس شرطة ساسكس، والمفتش غلين من أندوفر، والمشرف كارتر من شرطة ساسكس، والمفتش جاب، ومفتش أصغر سناً يُدعى كروم، وأيضاً الدكتور طومسون، الأخصائي الشهير في أمراض العقل.

sentences.text: Everyone was sure that the two letters were written by the same person.
sentences.translation: كان الجميع متأكدين من أن الرسالتين كتبهما نفس الشخص.

sentences.text: 'We've now got definite warning of a second crime which is going to take place on the 25th - the day after tomorrow - in Bexhill. What can we do to stop it?' said the Sussex Chief Constable.
sentences.translation: قال رئيس شرطة ساسكس.

sentences.text: He looked at his superintendent.
sentences.translation: نظر إلى المشرف الخاص به.

sentences.text: The Superintendent shook his head. 'It... difficult, sir. There's not the smallest clue about who the victim will be. What can we do?'
sentences.translation: هز المشرف رأسه.

sentences.text: 'I have a suggestion,' said Poirot. 'I think it is possible that the surname of the intended victim will begin with the letter B.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: When I got the letter naming Bexhill I thought it was possible that the victim as well as the place might be chosen in alphabetical order.
sentences.translation: عندما تلقيت الرسالة التي تذكر بيكسهيل، اعتقدت أنه من الممكن أن يكون كل من الضحية والمكان قد اختيرا بترتيب أبجدي.

sentences.text: 'It's possible,' said the doctor. 'On the other hand, it may be that the name Ascher was a coincidence. Remember that we are facing a madman. He hasn't given us any clue about his motive.'
sentences.translation: قال الطبيب.

sentences.text: 'Does a madman have motives, sir?' asked the Superintendent.
sentences.translation: سأل المشرف.

sentences.text: 'Of course he does,' said the doctor.
sentences.translation: قال الطبيب.

sentences.text: 'I'll keep a special watch on anyone connected with the Andover business,' said Inspector Glen. Partridge and Riddell and, of course, Ascher himself. If they show any sign of leaving Andover, they'll be followed.'
sentences.translation: قال المفتش غلين.

sentences.text: Later, Poirot and I walked along by the river.
sentences.translation: لاحقاً، سار بوارو وأنا على طول النهر.

sentences.text: 'Poirot,' I said. 'Surely this crime can be stopped?'
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: Poirot turned to me with a worried face. 'Madness, Hastings, is a terrible thing... I am afraid... I am very much afraid...'
sentences.translation: التفت إلي بوارو بوجه قلق.

sentences.text: I still remember waking up on the morning of 25 July. It was about seven-thirty.
sentences.translation: ما زلت أتذكر استيقاظي في صباح 25 يوليو. كان الوقت حوالي السابعة والنصف.

sentences.text: Poirot was standing by my bedside, gently shaking me by the shoulder. I looked at his face and was awake at once.
sentences.translation: كان بوارو واقفاً بجانب سريري، يهز كتفي بلطف. نظرت إلى وجهه واستيقظت فوراً.

sentences.text: 'What is it?' I asked, sitting up quickly.
sentences.translation: سألت، جالساً بسرعة.

sentences.text: 'It has happened,' Poirot said.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'What?' I cried. 'You mean - but today is the 25th.'
sentences.translation: صرخت.

sentences.text: 'It took place last night - I mean, in the early hours of this morning.'
I jumped out of bed and got dressed quickly. Poirot had just had a telephone call from Bexhill-on-Sea. He told me what had happened.
sentences.translation: قفزت من السرير وارتديت ملابسي بسرعة. كان بوارو قد تلقى للتو مكالمة هاتفية من بيكسهيل-أون-سي. أخبرني بما حدث.

sentences.text: 'The body of a young girl has been found on the beach at Bexhill,' he said. 'She is Elizabeth Barnard, a waitress in one of the cafes.'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: According to the medical examination, the time of death was between 11.30 p.m. and 1 a.m.
sentences.translation: وفقاً للفحص الطبي، كان وقت الوفاة بين الساعة 11:30 مساءً و1 صباحاً.

sentences.text: An ABC open at the trains to Bexhill was found under the body.'
sentences.translation: وُجد دليل ABC مفتوحاً على القطارات المتجهة إلى بيكسهيل تحت الجثة.

sentences.text: Twenty minutes later we were in a fast car crossing the Thames on our way out of London.
sentences.translation: بعد عشرين دقيقة كنا في سيارة سريعة نعبر نهر التايمز في طريقنا للخروج من لندن.

sentences.text: Inspector Crome was with us. He was officially in charge of the case.
sentences.translation: كان المفتش كروم معنا. كان مسؤولاً رسمياً عن القضية.

sentences.text: Crome was a very different type of officer from Japp. He was much younger, and seemed to think that he was a better detective than Poirot.
sentences.translation: كان كروم نوعاً مختلفاً جداً من الضباط عن جاب. كان أصغر بكثير، وبدا أنه يعتقد أنه محقق أفضل من بوارو.

sentences.text: If you want to ask me anything about the case, please do he said.
sentences.translation: إذا أردت أن تسألني أي شيء عن القضية، تفضل، قال.

sentences.text: 'You have not, I suppose, a description of the dead girl?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'She was twenty-three years old and was working as a waitress at the Orange Cat cafe -'
'Pas ca. I wondered - if she was pretty?'
'I have no information about that,' said Inspector Crome rather coldly.
sentences.translation: قال المفتش كروم ببرود نوعاً ما.

sentences.text: A look of amusement came into Poirot's eyes.
sentences.translation: ظهرت نظرة استمتاع في عيني بوارو.

sentences.text: 'It does not seem to you important? But for a woman, it is very important!'
There was a short silence. Then Poirot opened the conversation again.
sentences.translation: كان هناك صمت قصير. ثم فتح بوارو المحادثة مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: 'Were you informed how the girl was murdered?'
'She was strangled with her own belt,' replied Inspector Crome.
sentences.translation: رد المفتش كروم.

sentences.text: Poirot's eyes opened very wide.
sentences.translation: اتسعت عينا بوارو كثيراً.

sentences.text: 'Ah!' he said. At last we have a piece of information that is very definite. That tells one something, does it not?'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: At Bexhill we were greeted by Superintendent Carter.
sentences.translation: في بيكسهيل استقبلنا المشرف كارتر.

sentences.text: With him was a pleasant-faced, intelligent-looking young inspector called Kelsey.
sentences.translation: كان معه مفتش شاب لطيف الوجه وذكي المظهر يُدعى كيلسي.

sentences.text: 'We've told the girl's mother and father about her death,' said the Superintendent. 'It was a terrible shock to them, of course.'
sentences.translation: قال المشرف.

sentences.text: There's also a sister - a typist in London. We've communicated with her. And there's a young man - in fact, the girl was supposed to be out with him last night.'
sentences.translation: هناك أيضاً أخت - كاتبة على الآلة الكاتبة في لندن. لقد تواصلنا معها. وهناك شاب - في الواقع، كان من المفترض أن تخرج الفتاة معه الليلة الماضية.

sentences.text: 'Any help from the ABC guide?' asked Crome.
sentences.translation: سأل كروم.

sentences.text: 'It's there.' The Superintendent nodded towards the table. 'No fingerprints. It's open at the page for Bexhill. It's a new book, I think - it hasn't been opened much. It wasn't bought anywhere round here.'
sentences.translation: أومأ المشرف نحو الطاولة.

sentences.text: 'Who discovered the body, sir?'
'A retired army officer who was walking his dog at about 6 a.m.'
'Well, sir, I'd better start the interviews,' said Crome. 'There's the cafe and the girl's home. I'd better go to both of them. Kelsey can come with me.'
sentences.translation: قال كروم.

sentences.text: 'And Mr Poirot?' asked the Superintendent.
sentences.translation: سأل المشرف.

sentences.text: 'I will go with you,' said Poirot to Crome.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو لكروم.

sentences.text: Crome, I thought, looked a little annoyed.
sentences.translation: اعتقدت أن كروم بدا منزعجاً قليلاً.

sentences.text: We went to the Orange Cat, a small tearoom by the sea. It served coffee, tea and a few lunch dishes. Coffee was just being served.
sentences.translation: ذهبنا إلى أورنج كات، غرفة شاي صغيرة بجانب البحر. كانت تقدم القهوة والشاي وبعض أطباق الغداء. كانت القهوة تُقدم للتو.

sentences.text: The manageress took us into a very untidy back room.
sentences.translation: أخذتنا المديرة إلى غرفة خلفية غير مرتبة جداً.

sentences.text: 'Miss - eh - Merrion?' asked Crome.
sentences.translation: سأل كروم.

sentences.text: 'That is my name' said the manageress in a high voice. 'This is a very upsetting business. Most upsetting.'
sentences.translation: قالت المديرة بصوت عالٍ.

sentences.text: 'What can you tell me about the dead girl, Miss Merrion?' asked Kelsey. 'Had she worked here for a long time?'
sentences.translation: سأل كيلسي.

sentences.text: 'This was the second summer. She was a good waitress.'
'She was pretty, yes?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'She was a nice, clean-looking girl,' replied Miss Merrion.
sentences.translation: ردت الآنسة ميريون.

sentences.text: 'What time did she finish work last night?' Poirot continued.
sentences.translation: تابع بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Eight o'clock. We close at eight.'
'Did she tell you how she was going to spend the evening?'
'Certainly not,' said Miss Merrion. She looked shocked.
sentences.translation: قالت الآنسة ميريون. بدت مصدومة.

sentences.text: 'How many waitresses do you employ?'
'Two normally, and an extra two from 20 July until the end of August. Miss Barnard was one of the regular waitresses.'
'What about the other one?'
'Miss Higley? She's a very nice young lady.'
'Perhaps we had better ask her some questions.'
'I'll send her to you,' said Miss Merrion. 'Please be as quick as possible. This is the busiest time for morning coffees.'
sentences.translation: قالت الآنسة ميريون.

sentences.text: Miss Merrion left the room. A few minutes later a rather fat girl with dark hair and a pink face came in.
sentences.translation: غادرت الآنسة ميريون الغرفة. بعد بضع دقائق دخلت فتاة سمينة نوعاً ما ذات شعر داكن ووجه وردي.

sentences.text: 'Miss Higley,' asked the Inspector, 'you knew Elizabeth Barnard?'
sentences.translation: سأل المفتش،

sentences.text: 'Oh, yes, I knew Betty. Isn't it awful? Betty! Betty Barnard, murdered!'
'You knew the dead girl well?' asked Crome.
sentences.translation: سأل كروم.

sentences.text: 'Well, she's worked here longer than I have. I only came this March. She was here last year. She was rather quiet. She didn't joke or laugh a lot.'
We learned that Betty Barnard had had a good looking, well-dressed 'friend' who worked in an office near the station.
sentences.translation: علمنا أن بيتي بارنارد كان لديها
وسيم وأنيق يعمل في مكتب بالقرب من المحطة.

sentences.text: Miss Higley didn't know his name, but she had seen him and she thought Miss Barnard had planned to meet him the night before.
sentences.translation: لم تكن الآنسة هيغلي تعرف اسمه، لكنها رأته واعتقدت أن الآنسة بارنارد كانت تخطط للقائه الليلة الماضية.

sentences.text: We talked to the other two girls in the cafe, but no one had noticed her in Bexhill during the evening.
sentences.translation: تحدثنا إلى الفتاتين الأخريين في المقهى، لكن لم يلاحظها أحد في بيكسهيل خلال المساء.

sentences.text: CHAPTER FIVE
sentences.translation: الفصل الخامس

sentences.text: A Broken Family
sentences.translation: عائلة محطمة

sentences.text: Elizabeth Barnard's parents lived in a small newly built house on the edge of the town. Mr Barnard was waiting in the doorway for us.
sentences.translation: كان والدا إليزابيث بارنارد يعيشان في منزل صغير مبني حديثاً على حافة البلدة. كان السيد بارنارد ينتظرنا في المدخل.

sentences.text: Inspector Kelsey introduced himself, then he introduced us.
sentences.translation: عرّف المفتش كيلسي بنفسه، ثم عرّفنا.

sentences.text: 'This is Inspector Crome of Scotland Yard, sir,' he said.
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: 'Scotland Yard?' said Mr Barnard hopefully. 'That's good. This murderer has got to be caught. My poor little girl -'
sentences.translation: قال السيد بارنارد بأمل.

sentences.text: 'And this is Mr Hercule Poirot, also from London, and er -'
'Captain Hastings,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: We went into the living-room. Mrs Barnard was there. Her eyes were red, and she was clearly suffering from shock.
sentences.translation: دخلنا إلى غرفة المعيشة. كانت السيدة بارنارد هناك. كانت عيناها حمراء، وكانت تعاني بوضوح من الصدمة.

sentences.text: 'It's too cruel. Oh, it is too cruel,' she said in a tearful voice.
sentences.translation: قالت بصوت دامع.

sentences.text: 'It's very painful for you, madam, I know,' said Inspector Crome. 'But we want to know all the facts so we can get to work as quickly as possible.'
sentences.translation: قال المفتش كروم.

sentences.text: Your daughter was twenty-three, I understand. She lived here with you and worked at the Orange Cat cafe, is that right?'
sentences.translation: ابنتك كانت في الثالثة والعشرين، كما أفهم. كانت تعيش هنا معك وتعمل في مقهى أورنج كات، أليس كذلك؟

sentences.text: 'That's it,' said Mr Barnard.
sentences.translation: قال السيد بارنارد.

sentences.text: 'This is a new house, isn't it? Where did you live before?'
'I worked in London. I retired two years ago. We always wanted to live near the sea.'
'You have two daughters?'
'Yes. My older daughter works in an office in London.'
'Weren't you worried when your daughter didn't come home last night?'

'We didn't know she hadn't,' said Mrs Barnard in a tearful voice. 'Dad and I always go to bed at nine o'clock. We never knew Betty hadn't come home until the police officer came and said - and said -' She started to cry.
sentences.translation: قالت السيدة بارنارد بصوت دامع.
بدأت في البكاء.

sentences.text: 'We heard that your daughter was going to be married?'
'Yes. His name is Donald Fraser and I like him,' said Mrs Barnard. 'I like him very much. This news will be terrible for him.'
sentences.translation: قالت السيدة بارنارد.
