sentences.text: 'Did he meet your daughter most evenings after her work?'
'Not every evening. Once or twice a week.'
'Do you know if she was going to meet him yesterday?'
'She didn't say. Betty never said much about where she was going or what she was doing. But she was a good girl, Betty was.'
'We've got to find out what happened,' said Mr Barnard. 'Betty was just a happy girl with a nice boyfriend. Why should anyone want to murder her? It doesn't make sense.'
sentences.translation: قال السيد بارنارد.

sentences.text: 'You're right, Mr Barnard,' said Crome. 'I tell you what I'd like to do - have a look at Miss Barnard's room. There may be letters - or a diary,'
sentences.translation: قال كروم.

sentences.text: 'Certainly,' said Mr Barnard. He got up and led the way upstairs. Crome followed him, then Poirot, then Kelsey. I was at the back.
sentences.translation: قال السيد بارنارد. نهض وقاد الطريق إلى الطابق العلوي. تبعه كروم، ثم بوارو، ثم كيلسي. كنت في الخلف.

sentences.text: I paused for a minute on the stairs. As I did so, a taxi stopped outside and a girl jumped out.
sentences.translation: توقفت دقيقة على الدرج. وبينما فعلت ذلك، توقفت سيارة أجرة في الخارج وقفزت منها فتاة.

sentences.text: She paid the driver and hurried up the path, carrying a small suitcase. As she entered, she saw me and stopped.
sentences.translation: دفعت للسائق وأسرعت على الممر، حاملة حقيبة صغيرة. عندما دخلت، رأتني وتوقفت.

sentences.text: 'Who are you?' she said.
sentences.translation: قالت.

sentences.text: I came down a few steps. I felt embarrassed about how exactly to reply. Should I give my name? Or say that I had come here with the police?
sentences.translation: نزلت بضع درجات. شعرت بالحرج بشأن كيفية الرد بالضبط. هل أعطي اسمي؟ أم أقول إنني جئت إلى هنا مع الشرطة؟

sentences.text: 'Oh, well,' said the girl. 'I can guess.'
sentences.translation: قالت الفتاة.

sentences.text: She pulled off her hat and threw it on the ground. I could see her better now as she turned a little so the light fell on her.
sentences.translation: خلعت قبعتها وألقتها على الأرض. كان بإمكاني رؤيتها بشكل أفضل الآن وهي تدور قليلاً حتى يسقط الضوء عليها.

sentences.text: Her hair was black and cut in a modern fashion, and her body was thin. She was not good-looking, but there was something about her that made you notice her.
sentences.translation: كان شعرها أسود ومقصوصاً بطريقة عصرية، وجسدها نحيف. لم تكن جميلة، لكن كان هناك شيء فيها يجعلك تلاحظها.

sentences.text: 'You are Miss Barnard?' I asked.
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'I am Megan Barnard. You belong to the police, I suppose?'
'Well,' I said. 'Not exactly -'
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: She interrupted me.
sentences.translation: قاطعتني.

sentences.text: 'I don't think I've got anything to say to you. My sister was a nice girl with no men friends. Good morning.'
'I'm not a reporter, if that's what you think,' I said.
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'Well, what are you? Where are mum and dad?'
'Your father is showing the police your sister's bedroom. Your mother's in there. She's very upset.'
The girl seemed to make a decision. 'Come in here,' she said.
sentences.translation: بدت الفتاة وكأنها اتخذت قراراً.
قالت.

sentences.text: She pulled open a door and passed through. I followed her and found myself in a small, tidy kitchen.
sentences.translation: فتحت باباً ومرت عبره. تبعتها ووجدت نفسي في مطبخ صغير مرتب.

sentences.text: I was going to shut the door - but then Poirot came quietly into the room and closed the door behind him.
sentences.translation: كنت سأغلق الباب - لكن بوارو دخل الغرفة بهدوء وأغلق الباب خلفه.

sentences.text: 'Mademoiselle Barnard?' he said.
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: 'This is Monsieur Hercule Poirot,' I said.
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: Megan Barnard looked at him quickly.
sentences.translation: نظرت ميغان بارنارد إليه بسرعة.

sentences.text: 'I've heard of you,' she said. 'You're the private detective, aren't you?' She sat down on the edge of the kitchen table.
sentences.translation: قالت.
جلست على حافة طاولة المطبخ.

sentences.text: 'I don't see what Monsieur Hercule Poirot is doing in our little crime.'
'Mademoiselle,' said Poirot. 'I heard what you said just now to my friend Hastings.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.
فتاة لطيفة بدون أصدقاء من الرجال.

sentences.text: When a young girl is dead, that is the kind of thing that is said. But I should like to find someone who knew Elizabeth Barnard and who does not know she is dead!
sentences.translation: عندما تموت فتاة شابة، هذا هو نوع الشيء الذي يُقال. لكنني أود أن أجد شخصاً كان يعرف إليزابيث بارنارد ولا يعرف أنها ماتت!

sentences.text: Then, perhaps, I should hear what is useful to me - the truth!'
sentences.translation: عندئذٍ، ربما، سأسمع ما هو مفيد لي - الحقيقة!

sentences.text: Megan Barnard looked at him for a few minutes in silence. When at last she spoke, her words made me jump.
sentences.translation: نظرت ميغان بارنارد إليه لبضع دقائق في صمت. عندما تحدثت أخيراً، جعلت كلماتها أقفز.

sentences.text: 'Betty,' she said, 'was a stupid little fool! I was very fond of her, but I could see that she was very foolish. I even told her that sometimes.'
sentences.translation: قالت،

sentences.text: 'Please tell me exactly what you mean,' said Poirot. 'I will help you.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: I heard what you said to Hastings. That your sister was a bright happy girl with no men friends. It was the opposite that was true, was it not?'
sentences.translation: سمعت ما قلته لهاستينغز. أن أختك كانت فتاة مشرقة سعيدة بدون أصدقاء من الرجال. كان العكس هو الصحيح، أليس كذلك؟

sentences.text: Megan said slowly, 'Betty was a good girl. I want you to understand that. But she liked being taken out, and dancing and all that kind of thing.'
sentences.translation: قالت ميغان ببطء:

sentences.text: 'And she was pretty, yes?'
This was the third time that I had heard Poirot ask this question.
sentences.translation: كانت هذه المرة الثالثة التي أسمع فيها بوارو يطرح هذا السؤال.

sentences.text: Megan got down from the table and opened her suitcase. She took out a photo and handed it to Poirot.
sentences.translation: نزلت ميغان من الطاولة وفتحت حقيبتها. أخرجت صورة وسلمتها لبوارو.

sentences.text: It showed the head and shoulders of a fair-haired girl. She was not beautiful, but she had a cheap kind of prettiness.
sentences.translation: أظهرت رأس وكتفي فتاة شقراء. لم تكن جميلة، لكن كان لديها نوع رخيص من الجمال.

sentences.text: Poirot handed it back, saying, 'You and she do not look like each other, mademoiselle.'
sentences.translation: أعادها بوارو، قائلاً:

sentences.text: 'Oh, I'm the plain one of the family. I've always known that.'
'In what way do you think your sister was behaving foolishly?' asked Poirot. 'Do you mean, perhaps, in her relationship with Mr Donald Fraser?'
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'That's it, exactly. Don's a very quiet sort of person - but he - well, naturally he wouldn't be happy about certain things - and then -'
'And then what, mademoiselle?' Poirot gave her a long, hard look.
sentences.translation: أعطاها بوارو نظرة طويلة وحادة.

sentences.text: 'I was afraid that he might - end the relationship with her. And that would be a pity. He would be a good husband.'
Poirot continued to stare at her. She looked back at him.
sentences.translation: استمر بوارو في التحديق إليها. نظرت إليه بدورها.

sentences.text: 'So,' Poirot said at last, 'we do not speak the truth now.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو أخيراً،

sentences.text: 'Well,' said Megan, turning to the door, 'I've done what I can to help.'
sentences.translation: قالت ميغان، متجهة إلى الباب،

sentences.text: 'Wait, mademoiselle. I have something to tell you. Come back.'
To my surprise, Poirot told Megan Barnard the whole story of the ABC letters, the murder in Andover and the railway guide found by the bodies.
sentences.translation: لدهشتي، أخبر بوارو ميغان بارنارد القصة كاملة عن رسائل ABC، وجريمة القتل في أندوفر، ودليل السكك الحديدية الذي وُجد بجانب الجثث.

sentences.text: Megan listened to every word very carefully.
sentences.translation: استمعت ميغان إلى كل كلمة بعناية شديدة.

sentences.text: 'You really mean that my sister was killed by a madman?' she asked.
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'Exactly. You see, mademoiselle, you can give me the information I ask for freely, without wondering whether or not it will hurt anyone.'
'Yes, I see that now.'
'Then let us continue our conversation. I have formed the idea that this Donald Fraser has, perhaps, a violent and jealous temper. Is that right?'
Megan Barnard said quietly, 'I'm going to give you the whole truth now, Monsieur Poirot.'
sentences.translation: قالت ميغان بارنارد بهدوء:

sentences.text: Don is, as I say, a very quiet person. He keeps all his emotions inside himself. He can't always say what he feels in words. He was always jealous about Betty.
sentences.translation: دون، كما قلت، شخص هادئ جداً. يحتفظ بكل مشاعره داخله. لا يستطيع دائماً التعبير عن ما يشعر به بالكلمات. كان دائماً غيوراً على بيتي.

sentences.text: 'He loved her very much - and she was fond of him, but she liked other men, too.'
And of course, working in the Orange Cat, she was always meeting men.
sentences.translation: وبالطبع، كونها تعمل في أورنج كات، كانت دائماً تلتقي بالرجال.

sentences.text: And then perhaps she'd go with them to the cinema. Nothing serious, but she just liked to have fun.'
sentences.translation: وبعد ذلك ربما كانت تذهب معهم إلى السينما. لا شيء جدي، لكنها أحبت فقط الاستمتاع.

sentences.text: 'I understand,' said Poirot. 'Continue.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Don couldn't understand why she wanted to go out with other people. And once or twice they had terrible arguments.'
When quiet people lose their tempers, they get really angry. Don was so violent that Betty was frightened.
sentences.translation: عندما يفقد الهادئون أعصابهم، يصبحون غاضبين حقاً. كان دون عنيفاً لدرجة أن بيتي خافت.

sentences.text: 'There was one argument just over a month ago. I was at home for the weekend, and I told Betty she was being a little fool.'
She'd told Don she was going to Hastings to see a girlfriend - and he found out that she'd really been in Eastbourne with a married man.
sentences.translation: أخبرت دون أنها ذاهبة إلى هاستينغز لرؤية صديقة - واكتشف أنها كانت في الواقع في إيستبورن مع رجل متزوج.

sentences.text: There was a terrible scene. Don was white and shaking and saying that one day - one day -'
sentences.translation: كان هناك مشهد مروع. كان دون شاحباً ويرتجف ويقول إنه يوماً ما - يوماً ما -

sentences.text: 'Yes?'
'He'd murder her,' said Megan in a low voice.
sentences.translation: قالت ميغان بصوت منخفض.

sentences.text: She stopped and stared at Poirot. He nodded his head several times.
sentences.translation: توقفت وحدقت في بوارو. أومأ برأسه عدة مرات.

sentences.text: 'And so, naturally you were afraid...'
'I didn't think he'd actually done it!' said Megan. 'But I was afraid that the police would find out what he said - several people knew about it.'
sentences.translation: قالت ميغان.

sentences.text: 'Exactly. Do you know, mademoiselle, if your sister met this married man, or any other man, recently.'
'I don't know, said. Megan, shaking her head. 'But it wouldn't surprise me if Betty had - well, told Don a few lies again.'
sentences.translation: قالت ميغان، وهي تهز رأسها.

sentences.text: An electric bell rang sharply. Megan went to the window and looked out.
sentences.translation: رن جرس كهربائي بشكل حاد. ذهبت ميغان إلى النافذة ونظرت للخارج.

sentences.text: 'It's Don,' she said.
sentences.translation: قالت.

sentences.text: Bring him in here,' said Poirot quickly. 'I would like to have a word with him before the Inspector does.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو بسرعة.

sentences.text: Megan Barnard went quickly out of the kitchen. A couple of seconds later, she came back leading Donald Fraser by the hand.
sentences.translation: خرجت ميغان بارنارد بسرعة من المطبخ. بعد ثانيتين، عادت وهي تقود دونالد فريزر من يده.

sentences.text: I felt sorry for the young man. His white face showed how great a shock he had had. He was a fine-looking young man with a pleasant face and red hair.
sentences.translation: شعرت بالأسف على الشاب. أظهر وجهه الشاحب مدى الصدمة الكبيرة التي تعرض لها. كان شاباً وسيم المظهر بوجه لطيف وشعر أحمر.

sentences.text: 'What's this, Megan?' he said. 'Tell me, please - I've only just heard - Betty...' His voice grew quieter.
sentences.translation: قال.
خفت صوته.

sentences.text: Poirot pushed forward a chair and he sank down on it. Poirot gave him a drink. He sat up straighter and turned to Megan.
sentences.translation: دفع بوارو كرسياً إلى الأمام فجلس عليه. أعطاه بوارو مشروباً. جلس بشكل أكثر استقامة والتفت إلى ميغان.

sentences.text: 'It's true, I suppose?' he said quietly. 'Betty is - dead - killed?'
sentences.translation: قال بهدوء.

sentences.text: 'It's true, Don. I've just come down from London. Dad phoned me. The police are upstairs now.'
Looking through Betty's things, I suppose.'
sentences.translation: يبحثون في أشياء بيتي، كما أفترض.

sentences.text: Poirot moved forward a little and asked a question.
sentences.translation: تحرك بوارو قليلاً إلى الأمام وطرح سؤالاً.

sentences.text: 'Did Miss Barnard tell you where she was going last night?'
'She told me she was going with a girlfriend to St Leonards replied Fraser.'
sentences.translation: رد فريزر.

sentences.text: 'Did you believe her?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'What do you mean?' Suddenly Fraser's face looked angry.
sentences.translation: فجأة بدا وجه فريزر غاضباً.

sentences.text: 'Betty Barnard was killed by a madman,' said Poirot. 'You can only help us to catch him by speaking the exact truth.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: Donald Fraser turned to Megan. Then he looked suspiciously at Poirot.
sentences.translation: التفت دونالد فريزر إلى ميغان. ثم نظر إلى بوارو بارتياب.

sentences.text: 'Who are you? You don't belong to the police?'
'I am better than the police,' said Poirot simply.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو ببساطة.

sentences.text: 'Well,' Donald Fraser said at last, 'I - I began to wonder. I was ashamed of myself for being so suspicious. But - but I was suspicious...'
sentences.translation: قال دونالد فريزر أخيراً،

sentences.text: I went to St Leonards. I got there by eight o'clock. Then I watched the buses - to see she was in them... But there was no sign of her.
sentences.translation: ذهبت إلى سانت ليوناردز. وصلت إلى هناك بحلول الساعة الثامنة. ثم راقبت الحافلات - لأرى إن كانت فيها... لكن لم يكن هناك أي أثر لها.

sentences.text: 'I was sure she was with a man. I went to Hastings. I looked in hotels and restaurants and cinemas. It was very foolish.'
So in the end I came back. It was about midnight when I got home.'
sentences.translation: لذا في النهاية عدت. كان الوقت حوالي منتصف الليل عندما وصلت إلى المنزل.

sentences.text: The kitchen door opened. 'Oh, there you are,' said Inspector Kelsey.
sentences.translation: فتح باب المطبخ.
قال المفتش كيلسي.

sentences.text: Inspector Crome pushed past him. He looked quickly at the two strangers.
sentences.translation: دفع المفتش كروم من جانبه. نظر بسرعة إلى الغريبين.

sentences.text: 'Miss Megan Barnard and Mr Donald Fraser,' said Poirot, introducing them, 'This is Inspector Crome from London.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو، مقدماً إياهم،

sentences.text: Turning to the Inspector, he said, 'While you were upstairs, I was talking to Miss Barnard and Mr Fraser to see if they could tell me anything which would help us.'
sentences.translation: ثم التفت إلى المفتش وقال:

sentences.text: 'Oh yes?' said Inspector Crome, not really listening to Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال المفتش كروم، وهو لا يستمع حقاً لبوارو.

sentences.text: Poirot went out into the hall and I followed him.
sentences.translation: خرج بوارو إلى القاعة وتبعته.

sentences.text: 'Have you had any new ideas about the crimes?' I asked him.
sentences.translation: سألته.

sentences.text: 'Only that the murderer is a surprisingly kind sort of person,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: I had no idea what Poirot meant. But I did not say anything.
sentences.translation: لم تكن لدي أي فكرة عما قصده بوارو. لكنني لم أقل شيئاً.

sentences.text: CHAPTER SIX
sentences.translation: الفصل السادس

sentences.text: The Third Letter
sentences.translation: الرسالة الثالثة

sentences.text: After the Bexhill murder, we had many more meetings with the police.
sentences.translation: بعد جريمة بيكسهيل، كان لدينا العديد من الاجتماعات مع الشرطة.

sentences.text: There was a lot of discussion about whether the general public should be told about the anonymous letters.
sentences.translation: كان هناك الكثير من النقاش حول ما إذا كان ينبغي إخبار عامة الناس بالرسائل المجهولة.

sentences.text: 'If we don't give this madman the satisfaction of telling everyone about him, what's he likely to do?' asked Inspector Crome.
sentences.translation: سأل المفتش كروم.

sentences.text: 'He'll murder someone else,' said Dr Thomson at once.
sentences.translation: قال الدكتور طومسون فوراً.

sentences.text: 'And if we put everything in the newspapers, then what will he do?'
'Same answer. The result's the same. Another crime.'
'But it seems to me,' said Poirot, 'that there is one very important clue - the discovery of the motive.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو،

sentences.text: He chooses his victims alphabetically - not because he hates them personally. But why is he murdering these people?
sentences.translation: إنه يختار ضحاياه أبجدياً - ليس لأنه يكرههم شخصياً. لكن لماذا يقتل هؤلاء الناس؟

sentences.text: 'He is a very kind murderer. The police didn't arrest Franz Ascher for the murder of his wife and Donald Fraser for the murder of Betty Barnard because ABC wrote those warning letters.'
I remember well the arrival of ABC's third letter.
sentences.translation: أتذكر جيداً وصول رسالة ABC الثالثة.

sentences.text: It was a Friday. The evening post came at about ten o'clock.
sentences.translation: كان يوم جمعة. وصل بريد المساء في حوالي الساعة العاشرة.

sentences.text: When we heard the postman's step, I went along to the letter-box. There were four or five letters, I remember. The last one was addressed in printed letters.
sentences.translation: عندما سمعنا خطوات ساعي البريد، ذهبت إلى صندوق الرسائل. كانت هناك أربع أو خمس رسائل، كما أتذكر. الأخيرة كانت معنونة بحروف مطبوعة.

sentences.text: I opened it quickly and took out the printed piece of paper inside.
sentences.translation: فتحتها بسرعة وأخرجت الورقة المطبوعة بالداخل.

sentences.text: Poor Mr Poirot, - You aren't as good at these little criminal matters as you thought, are you?
sentences.translation: سيد بوارو المسكين، - أنت لست جيداً في هذه الأمور الإجرامية الصغيرة كما اعتقدت، أليس كذلك؟

sentences.text: Let us see if you can do any better this time. This time it's easy.
sentences.translation: لنرَ إن كان بإمكانك فعل أي شيء أفضل هذه المرة. هذه المرة الأمر سهل.

sentences.text: Churston on the 30th. Do try and do something about it.
sentences.translation: تشيرستون في الثلاثين. حاول أن تفعل شيئاً بشأن ذلك.

sentences.text: It's a bit boring for me when everything goes so easily, you know!
sentences.translation: إنه أمر ممل قليلاً بالنسبة لي عندما يسير كل شيء بهذه السهولة، كما تعلم!

sentences.text: Good hunting. Ever yours, ABC
sentences.translation: صيداً سعيداً. مخلصك دائماً، ABC

sentences.text: 'Churston,' I said, jumping to get our own ABC. 'Lets see where it is.'
sentences.translation: قلت، مقفزاً لأحضر دليل ABC الخاص بنا.

sentences.text: 'Hastings,' said Poirot, 'when was that letter written? Is there a date on it?'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو،

sentences.text: 'It was written on the 27th,' I said, looking at the letter in my hand.
sentences.translation: قلت، ناظراً إلى الرسالة في يدي.

sentences.text: 'Did I hear you right, Hastings? Did he give the date of the murder as the 30th? Bon Dieu, Hastings - do you not realise? Today is the 30th.'
Poirot picked up the envelope from the floor. There was something unusual about the address, but I had been too worried to look at it closely.
sentences.translation: رفع بوارو الظرف من الأرض. كان هناك شيء غير عادي في العنوان، لكنني كنت قلقاً جداً لأنظر إليه عن كثب.

sentences.text: Poirot was at that time living in Whitehaven Apartments. The address on the envelope said, Hercule Poirot, Whitehorse Apartments.
sentences.translation: كان بوارو في ذلك الوقت يعيش في شقق وايتهافن. قال العنوان على الظرف: هرقل بوارو، شقق وايتهاوس.

sentences.text: Someone had written across the envelope, 'Not known at Whitehorse Apartments, EC1, - try Whitehaven Apartments.'
sentences.translation: كتب شخص ما عبر الظرف:

sentences.text: So the letter had been sent to the wrong address three days before.
sentences.translation: لذا كانت الرسالة قد أُرسلت إلى العنوان الخطأ قبل ثلاثة أيام.

sentences.text: 'Quickly!' said Poirot. 'We must get in touch with Scotland Yard.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: He telephoned Crome and told him about the letter. Crome then put down the phone to book a ticket to Churston.
sentences.translation: اتصل هاتفياً بكروم وأخبره عن الرسالة. ثم أغلق كروم الهاتف ليحجز تذكرة إلى تشيرستون.

sentences.text: 'It is too late,' said Poirot. He looked at the clock. 'It's twenty past ten. There is only another hour and forty minutes.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو. نظر إلى الساعة.

sentences.text: I opened the railway guide I had taken down from the shelf.
sentences.translation: فتحت دليل السكك الحديدية الذي كنت قد أنزلته من الرف.

sentences.text: 'Churston, Devon,' I read, '327.6 kilometres from Paddington. Population 656. It's a small place. Surely our man would be noticed there.'
sentences.translation: قرأت،

sentences.text: 'But another person will be dead,' said Poirot. 'What time are the trains? I imagine that a train will be quicker than a car.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'There's a midnight train from Paddington - it gets to Churston at 7.15.'
'We will take that, Hastings.'
I put a few things into a suitcase while Poirot again rang up Scotland Yard.
sentences.translation: وضعت بعض الأشياء في حقيبة بينما اتصل بوارو مرة أخرى بسكوتلاند يارد.

sentences.text: A few minutes later, he came into the bedroom and explained that we had to take the letter and envelope to Paddington with us. Someone from Scotland Yard would meet us there.
sentences.translation: بعد بضع دقائق، دخل غرفة النوم وشرح أنه يجب علينا أخذ الرسالة والظرف معنا إلى بادينغتون. سيلتقي بنا شخص من سكوتلاند يارد هناك.

sentences.text: When we arrived on the platform, we saw Inspector Crome.
sentences.translation: عندما وصلنا إلى الرصيف، رأينا المفتش كروم.

sentences.text: 'We don't have any news yet,' he said. 'All persons whose names begin with C are being warned by phone if possible. Where's the letter?'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: Poirot gave it to him and he examined it.
sentences.translation: أعطاها له بوارو وفحصها.

sentences.text: 'You don't think,' I suggested, 'that he put the wrong address on purpose?'
sentences.translation: اقترحت،

sentences.text: 'No,' said Crome, shaking his head. 'The man's got his rules - crazy rules - and he keeps to them. He gives us warning.'
sentences.translation: قال كروم، وهو يهز رأسه.

sentences.text: The Inspector, we found, was travelling by the same train. Just as the train was leaving the station, we saw a man running down the platform.
sentences.translation: اكتشفنا أن المفتش كان مسافراً بنفس القطار. وبينما كان القطار يغادر المحطة، رأينا رجلاً يركض على الرصيف.

sentences.text: He reached the Inspector's window and called up something. Poirot and I hurried down the train.
sentences.translation: وصل إلى نافذة المفتش ونادى بشيء. أسرع بوارو وأنا في القطار.

sentences.text: 'You have news - yes?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: Crome said quietly, 'It's very bad. Sir Carmichael Clarke has been found murdered.'
sentences.translation: قال كروم بهدوء:

sentences.text: Sir Carmichael Clarke was quite famous. He had been a throat specialist but had retired.
sentences.translation: كان السير كارمايكل كلارك مشهوراً جداً. كان أخصائياً في الحنجرة لكنه تقاعد.

sentences.text: He was rich and owned one of the best-known collections of Chinese art.
sentences.translation: كان ثرياً ويمتلك واحدة من أشهر مجموعات الفن الصيني.

sentences.text: He was married but had no children, and lived in a house he had built for himself near the Devon coast.
sentences.translation: كان متزوجاً لكن ليس لديه أطفال، وعاش في منزل بناه لنفسه بالقرب من ساحل ديفون.

sentences.text: 'Eh bien,' said Poirot. 'The whole country will look for ABC.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Unfortunately,' I said, 'that's what he wants.'
sentences.translation: قلت،

sentences.text: 'True. But he may become careless...'
'How strange all this is, Poirot,' I said. 'Do you know, this is the first crime of this kind that you and I have worked on together?'
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: All our murders have been - well, private murders. This murder is worse because it's mad.'
sentences.translation: كل جرائمنا القتل كانت - حسناً، جرائم قتل خاصة. هذه الجريمة أسوأ لأنها مجنونة.

sentences.text: 'No, Hastings. It is not worse. It is only more difficult. It should be easier to discover because it is mad.'
This alphabetical business... If I could understand the idea - then everything would be clear and simple. These crimes must not continue.
sentences.translation: هذه المسألة الأبجدية... لو تمكنت من فهم الفكرة - عندها سيكون كل شيء واضحاً وبسيطاً. يجب ألا تستمر هذه الجرائم.

sentences.text: Soon, soon, I must see the truth... Go, Hastings. Get some sleep. There will be a lot to do tomorrow.'
sentences.translation: قريباً، قريباً، يجب أن أرى الحقيقة... اذهب يا هاستينغز. خذ قسطاً من النوم. سيكون هناك الكثير لنفعله غداً.

sentences.text: Churston is near the town of Torquay. Until about ten years ago there was only countryside around it, but recently small houses and new roads had appeared.
sentences.translation: تشيرستون تقع بالقرب من بلدة توركاي. حتى حوالي عشر سنوات مضت لم يكن حولها سوى الريف، لكن ظهرت مؤخراً منازل صغيرة وطرق جديدة.

sentences.text: Sir Carmichael Clarke had bought land with an open view of the sea and built a house. It was modern, and not large, but quite attractive.
sentences.translation: اشترى السير كارمايكل كلارك أرضاً بإطلالة مفتوحة على البحر وبنى منزلاً. كان عصرياً، وليس كبيراً، لكنه جذاب جداً.

sentences.text: A local police officer, Inspector Wells, met us at the station and told us what had happened.
sentences.translation: استقبلنا في المحطة ضابط شرطة محلي، المفتش ويلز، وأخبرنا بما حدث.

sentences.text: Sir Carmichael Clarke, it seemed, had been in the habit of taking a walk after dinner every evening.
sentences.translation: بدا أن السير كارمايكل كلارك كان معتاداً على القيام بنزهة بعد العشاء كل مساء.

sentences.text: But at some time after eleven, he had still not returned. It was not long before his body was discovered.
sentences.translation: لكن في وقت ما بعد الحادية عشرة، لم يكن قد عاد بعد. لم يمض وقت طويل قبل اكتشاف جثته.

sentences.text: He had been hit on the back of the head with something heavy. An open ABC bad been placed face down on the dead body.
sentences.translation: كان قد ضُرب على مؤخرة رأسه بشيء ثقيل. وُضع دليل ABC مفتوحاً ووجهه لأسفل على الجثة.

sentences.text: We arrived at Combeside, Sir Carmichael's house, at about eight o'clock. The door was opened by a manservant.
sentences.translation: وصلنا إلى كومبسايد، منزل السير كارمايكل، في حوالي الساعة الثامنة. فتح الباب خادم.

sentences.text: His hands were shaking and he looked very upset.
sentences.translation: كانت يداه ترتجفان وبدا مستاءً جداً.

sentences.text: 'Good morning, Deveril,' said the police officer. 'These are the gentleman from London.'
sentences.translation: قال ضابط الشرطة.

sentences.text: 'This way, gentlemen,' said Deveril. He showed us into a long dining-room where breakfast was laid. 'I'll get Mr Franklin.'
sentences.translation: قال ديفريل. أرشدنا إلى غرفة طعام طويلة حيث كانت الفطور مُعدّاً.

sentences.text: A minute later, a big, fair-haired man with a sunburnt face entered the room. This was Franklin Clarke, the dead man's only brother.
sentences.translation: بعد دقيقة، دخل الغرفة رجل كبير، أشقر الشعر، بوجه مدبوغ من الشمس. كان هذا فرانكلين كلارك، شقيق الرجل الميت الوحيد.

sentences.text: Inspector Wells introduced us to him. Franklin Clarke shook hands with each of us in turn.
sentences.translation: قدمنا المفتش ويلز إليه. صافح فرانكلين كلارك كل واحد منا بدوره.

sentences.text: 'Let me offer you some breakfast,' he said. 'We can talk as we eat.'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: We ate the excellent breakfast and drank coffee.
sentences.translation: أكلنا الفطور الممتاز وشربنا القهوة.

sentences.text: 'Inspector Wells told me everything last night,' said Franklin Clarke. 'Is it really right, Inspector Crome, that my poor brother is the victim of a mad killer, that this is the third murder, and that, in each case, an ABC railway guide has been left beside the body?'
sentences.translation: قال فرانكلين كلارك.

sentences.text: 'That's right, Mr Clarke.'
'But why? What possible advantage can there be for the murderer?'
'It won't help us if we look for motives now, Mr Clarke.' said Inspector Crome. 'We need a few facts.'
sentences.translation: قال المفتش كروم.

sentences.text: Your brother was the same as usual yesterday? He received no unexpected letter - nothing to upset him?'
sentences.translation: هل كان أخوك كما هو معتاد أمس؟ لم يتلق أي رسالة غير متوقعة - لا شيء يزعجه؟

sentences.text: 'No, he was quite as usual.'
'Not upset or worried in any way?'
'Excuse me, Inspector, I didn't say that. It was normal for my poor brother to be upset and worried.'
You may not know that his wife, Lady Clarke, is in very bad health. She is suffering from a terrible illness and will not live for long.
sentences.translation: قد لا تعلم أن زوجته، الليدي كلارك، في صحة سيئة جداً. إنها تعاني من مرض رهيب ولن تعيش طويلاً.

sentences.text: My brother is very worried about her. I returned from the East not long ago and I was shocked at the change in him.
sentences.translation: أخي قلق جداً عليها. عدت من الشرق منذ وقت ليس ببعيد وصُدمت من التغير الذي طرأ عليه.

sentences.text: 'Imagine, Mr Clarke, that you found your brother shot - with a gun beside him. What would you think?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'I would think that he killed himself,' said Clarke.
sentences.translation: قال كلارك.

sentences.text: 'But he didn't kill himself,' said Crome. 'Now I believe, Mr Clarke, that it was your brother's habit to go for a walk every evening?'
sentences.translation: قال كروم.

sentences.text: 'Quite right. He always did.'
'I suppose a stranger would be easily noticed around here?'
'No, in August many tourists come here in cars and buses and on foot - unfortunately.'
You've no idea how beautiful and peaceful this part of the world is in June and at the beginning of July.
sentences.translation: ليس لديك فكرة عن مدى جمال وسلام هذا الجزء من العالم في يونيو وفي بداية يوليو.

sentences.text: 'Did any stranger come to the house and ask for Sir Carmichael yesterday?'
'Not that I know of - but we'll ask Deveril.'
He rang the bell and put the question to the manservant.
sentences.translation: رن الجرس وطرح السؤال على الخادم.

sentences.text: 'No, sir, no one came to see Sir Carmichael.'
As Deveril left the room, a young woman came in.
sentences.translation: عندما غادر ديفريل الغرفة، دخلت امرأة شابة.

sentences.text: 'This is Miss Thora Grey,' said Franklin Clarke. 'My brother's secretary.'
sentences.translation: قال فرانكلين كلارك.

sentences.text: The girl was very fair. She had the very fair hair and light grey eyes that one finds among Norwegians and Swedes.
sentences.translation: كانت الفتاة شقراء جداً. كان لديها الشعر الأشقر جداً والعيون الرمادية الفاتحة التي تجدها بين النرويجيين والسويديين.

sentences.text: She looked about twenty-seven. Clarke brought her a cup of coffee, but she refused any food.
sentences.translation: بدت في حوالي السابعة والعشرين. أحضر لها كلارك فنجان قهوة، لكنها رفضت أي طعام.

sentences.text: 'Did you see the letters that Sir Carmichael received?' asked Crome. 'I suppose he never received a letter or letters signed ABC?'
sentences.translation: سأل كروم.

sentences.text: 'ABC?' She shook her head. 'No, I'm sure he didn't.'
sentences.translation: هزت رأسها.

sentences.text: 'He didn't say he had noticed anyone during his evening walks recently? Have you yourself noticed any strangers?'
'No. Of course there are a lot of people here at this time of year.'
Inspector Crome asked to be shown the path of Sir Carmichael's nightly walk.
sentences.translation: طلب المفتش كروم أن يُرى مسار نزهة السير كارمايكل الليلية.

sentences.text: Franklin Clarke led the way and we followed.
sentences.translation: قاد فرانكلين كلارك الطريق وتبعناه.

sentences.text: Thora Grey and I were walking a little behind the others.
sentences.translation: كنت أنا وثورا غراي نسير خلف الآخرين قليلاً.

sentences.text: 'I expect this has been a terrible shock to his wife,' I said.
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'Lady Clarke is usually drugged. She doesn't know what's happening for a lot of the time,' replied Miss Grey.
sentences.translation: ردت الآنسة غراي.

sentences.text: We went out through the garden gate, and then along a small path leading down to the sea.
sentences.translation: خرجنا عبر بوابة الحديقة، ثم على طول ممر صغير يؤدي إلى البحر.

sentences.text: Suddenly we came out to a place covered with grass which looked out over a beach of white stones.
sentences.translation: فجأة وصلنا إلى مكان مغطى بالعشب يطل على شاطئ من الحجارة البيضاء.

sentences.text: All around dark green trees ran down to the sea. It was a beautiful place - white, deep-green and bright blue.
sentences.translation: كانت الأشجار الخضراء الداكنة تحيط بالمكان وتنحدر نحو البحر. كان مكاناً جميلاً - أبيض، وأخضر داكن، وأزرق ساطع.

sentences.text: 'This was my brother's evening walk,' said Clarke. 'He came here, then back up the path. Then he went across the fields back to the house.'
sentences.translation: قال كلارك.

sentences.text: We continued and came to a place near some trees, half-way across the field where the body had been found.
sentences.translation: تابعنا ووصلنا إلى مكان بالقرب من بعض الأشجار، في منتصف الطريق عبر الحقل حيث وُجدت الجثة.

sentences.text: 'The murderer probably stood here in the shadow,' said Crome. 'Your brother almost certainly noticed nothing until he was struck down.'
sentences.translation: قال كروم.

sentences.text: We went back to the house. As we climbed up the stairs, the doctor came out of a room where the body had been taken, with a black bag in his hand.
sentences.translation: عدنا إلى المنزل. وبينما كنا نصعد الدرج، خرج الطبيب من غرفة كانت الجثة قد نُقلت إليها، وحقيبة سوداء في يده.

sentences.text: 'It's a very simple case,' he said. He didn't suffer. Death happened immediately. I'll just go and see Lady Clarke.'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: A hospital nurse came out of another room, and the doctor joined her. We went to look at Sir Carmichael's body, and came out again quickly.
sentences.translation: خرجت ممرضة من غرفة أخرى، وانضم إليها الطبيب. ذهبنا للنظر إلى جثة السير كارمايكل، وخرجنا مرة أخرى بسرعة.

sentences.text: Miss Grey was standing at the head of the stairs. She looked upset. 'Miss Grey -' I stopped. 'Is anything the matter?'
sentences.translation: كانت الآنسة غراي واقفة عند رأس الدرج. بدت مستاءة.
توقفت.

sentences.text: 'I was thinking,' she said, 'about D. About the next murder. Something must be done. It has to be stopped.'
sentences.translation: قالت،

sentences.text: Clarke came out of a room behind me. 'What has to be stopped, Thora?'
sentences.translation: خرج كلارك من غرفة خلفي.

sentences.text: 'These awful murders.'
'Yes. I want to talk to Monsieur Poirot some time... Is Crome any good?'
I replied that he was supposed to be a very clever officer.
sentences.translation: أجبت بأنه من المفترض أن يكون ضابطاً ذكياً جداً.

sentences.text: 'He has the look of a man who knows everything, said Clarke,
sentences.translation: قال كلارك،

sentences.text: He knocked at the door where the doctor had entered.
sentences.translation: طرق الباب الذي دخل منه الطبيب.

sentences.text: Miss Grey was still staring in front of her.
sentences.translation: كانت الآنسة غراي لا تزال تحدق أمامها.

sentences.text: 'What are you thinking, Miss Grey?' I asked.
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'I'm wondering where he is now... the murderer, I mean.'
She went downstairs. I stood there thinking about her words.
sentences.translation: نزلت الدرج. وقفت هناك أفكر في كلماتها.

sentences.text: ABC... Where was he now...?
sentences.translation: ABC... أين هو الآن...؟

sentences.text: CHAPTER SEVEN
sentences.translation: الفصل السابع

sentences.text: The Special Legion
sentences.translation: الفيلق الخاص

sentences.text: 'Only one thing connects these three people - the fact that the same person killed them.'
Mr Alexander Bonaparte Cust left the cinema in Torquay with the rest of the people. He looked around him uncertainly in the brightness of the afternoon sunshine, like a lost dog.
sentences.translation: غادر السيد ألكسندر بونابرت كاست السينما في توركاي مع بقية الناس. نظر حوله بعدم يقين في سطوع شمس بعد الظهر، مثل كلب ضائع.

sentences.text: Newsboys went past, shouting: 'Latest news... Mad Killer at Churston...'
sentences.translation: مر باعة الصحف صارخين:

sentences.text: Mr Cust found a coin in his pocket, and bought a paper. He entered the Princess Gardens and sat down. Then he opened the paper.
sentences.translation: وجد السيد كاست عملة في جيبه، واشترى صحيفة. دخل حدائق الأميرة وجلس. ثم فتح الصحيفة.

sentences.text: There were big headlines: SIR CARMICHAEL CLARKE MURDERED.
sentences.translation: كانت هناك عناوين كبيرة: مقتل السير كارمايكل كلارك.

sentences.text: TERRIBLE EVENT AT CHURSTON. WORK OF A MAD KILLER.
sentences.translation: حدث مروع في تشيرستون. عمل قاتل مجنون.

sentences.text: Only a month ago England was shocked by the murder of a young girl, Elizabeth Barnard, at Bexhill.
sentences.translation: قبل شهر واحد فقط صُدمت إنجلترا بجريمة قتل فتاة شابة، إليزابيث بارنارد، في بيكسهيل.

sentences.text: It may be remembered that an ABC railway guide was found beside the body. An ABC was also found by the dead body of Sir Carmichael Clarke.
sentences.translation: قد يُتذكر أنه وُجد دليل سكك حديدية ABC بجانب الجثة. كما وُجد دليل ABC بجانب جثة السير كارمايكل كلارك.

sentences.text: The police think the same person is responsible for both murders. Is it possible that a mad killer is going round our stride towns?
sentences.translation: تعتقد الشرطة أن نفس الشخص مسؤول عن كلتا الجريمتين. هل من الممكن أن قاتلاً مجنوناً يتجول في بلداتنا؟

sentences.text: A young man in a bright blue shirt was sitting beside Mr Cust.
sentences.translation: كان شاب يرتدي قميصاً أزرق ساطعاً يجلس بجانب السيد كاست.

sentences.text: 'A nasty business - eh?' he said.
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: Mr Cust jumped in surprise. 'Oh, very - very-'
sentences.translation: قفز السيد كاست مندهشاً.

sentences.text: The young man noticed that his hands were shaking so much that he couldn't held the paper very well.
sentences.translation: لاحظ الشاب أن يديه كانتا ترتجفان بشدة لدرجة أنه لم يستطع حمل الصحيفة جيداً.

sentences.text: 'Mad people don't always look mad,' said the young man. 'Often they seem just like you or me... Sometimes it's the war that made them go mad.'
sentences.translation: قال الشاب.

sentences.text: 'I - I expect you're right.'
'I don't agree with wars,' said the young man. 'They should be stopped'
sentences.translation: قال الشاب.

sentences.text: Mr Cust laughed, he laughed for some time. The young man was worried.
sentences.translation: ضحك السيد كاست، ضحك لبعض الوقت. كان الشاب قلقاً.

sentences.text: 'He's a bit mad himself,' he thought.
sentences.translation: فكر.

sentences.text: 'Sorry, sir,' he said. 'I expect you were in the war.'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: 'I was,' said Mr Cust. 'My head's never been right since. It aches, you know. It aches terribly. Sometimes I don't know what I'm doing...'
sentences.translation: قال السيد كاست.

sentences.text: The young man went away quickly. Mr Cust stayed with his paper. He read it and read it again.
sentences.translation: ذهب الشاب بعيداً بسرعة. بقي السيد كاست مع صحيفته. قرأها وقرأها مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: People passed backwards and forwards in front of him. Most of them were talking about the murder.
sentences.translation: كان الناس يمرون ذهاباً وإياباً أمامه. كان معظمهم يتحدثون عن الجريمة.

sentences.text: '- police are sure to get him -'
'- say he may be jested at any time now -'
'- quite likely he's in Torquay -'
Mr Cust laid the paper on the seat. Then he got up and walked towards the town.
sentences.translation: وضع السيد كاست الصحيفة على المقعد. ثم نهض وسار نحو البلدة.

sentences.text: Girls passed him, girls in white and pink and blue. They laughed, looking at the men as they passed them.
sentences.translation: مرت به فتيات، فتيات باللون الأبيض والوردي والأزرق. ضحكن، ناظرات إلى الرجال أثناء مرورهن بهم.

sentences.text: But they didn't look once at Mr Cust.
sentences.translation: لكنهن لم ينظرن ولو مرة واحدة إلى السيد كاست.

sentences.text: He sat down at a little table and ordered tea.
sentences.translation: جلس على طاولة صغيرة وطلب الشاي.

sentences.text: After the murder of Sir Carmichael Clarke, the ABC murders were in every newspaper.
sentences.translation: بعد جريمة قتل السير كارمايكل كلارك، كانت جرائم ABC في كل صحيفة.

sentences.text: The Andover murder was now connected with the other two. Scotland Yard believed that the best chance of catching the murderer was to make the murders as public as possible.
sentences.translation: كانت جريمة أندوفر مرتبطة الآن بالجريمتين الأخريين. اعتقدت سكوتلاند يارد أن أفضل فرصة للقبض على القاتل كانت جعل الجرائم علنية قدر الإمكان.

sentences.text: The population of Great Britain turned into private detectives, looking for the murderer. One newspaper wrote:
sentences.translation: تحول سكان بريطانيا العظمى إلى محققين خاصين، يبحثون عن القاتل. كتبت إحدى الصحف:

sentences.text: HE MAY BE IN YOUR TOWN!
sentences.translation: قد يكون في بلدتك!

sentences.text: The newspapers printed the letters that had been sent to Poirot. Newspaper reporters kept asking Poirot for interviews.
sentences.translation: طبعتب الصحف الرسائل التي أُرسلت إلى بوارو. استمر مراسلو الصحف في طلب مقابلات مع بوارو.

sentences.text: Scotland Yard were very active, working hard to check the smallest clues. They questioned people in hotels and guesthouses.
sentences.translation: كانت سكوتلاند يارد نشطة جداً، تعمل بجد للتحقق من أصغر الأدلة. استجوبوا الناس في الفنادق وبيوت الضيافة.

sentences.text: They listened to hundreds of stories from imaginative people and checked them to see if they were true.
sentences.translation: استمعوا إلى مئات القصص من أشخاص خياليين وتحققوا منها ليروا إن كانت صحيحة.

sentences.text: But Poirot seemed to me strangely inactive. Sometimes we argued.
sentences.translation: لكن بوارو بدا لي غير نشط بشكل غريب. أحياناً كنا نتجادل.

sentences.text: 'But what do you want me to do, my friend?' Poirot said. 'The police can question people better than I can.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: All the time, while I seem to be doing nothing, I am thinking - not about the facts of the case - but about the mind of the murderer.'
sentences.translation: طوال الوقت، بينما أبدو وكأنني لا أفعل شيئاً، أنا أفكر - ليس في حقائق القضية - بل في عقل القاتل.

sentences.text: 'The mind of a madman!'
'Exactly. When I know what the murderer is like, I shall be able to find out who he is. And all the time, I learn more.'
After the next crime-'
sentences.translation: بعد الجريمة القادمة-

sentences.text: 'Poirot!'
'But, yes, Hastings, I think it is almost certain there will be another crime.'
Our unknown killer has been lucky, but this time his luck may change. And after another crime, we shall know a lot more.
sentences.translation: كان قاتلنا المجهول محظوظاً، لكن هذه المرة قد يتغير حظه. وبعد جريمة أخرى، سنعرف الكثير.

sentences.text: I shall not know his name and address! But I shall know what kind of a man he is...
sentences.translation: لن أعرف اسمه وعنوانه! لكنني سأعرف أي نوع من الرجال هو...

sentences.text: 'Now I am going to do something which will please you,' Poirot continue. 'It will mean a lot of conversation.'
sentences.translation: تابع بوارو.

sentences.text: I want to find out more information from the friends, relatives and servants of the victims.'
sentences.translation: أريد معرفة المزيد من المعلومات من أصدقاء وأقارب وخدم الضحايا.

sentences.text: 'Do you suspect them of hiding things?'
'I don't think they meant to hide information. But at the time of a murder, people talk about only what they think is important.'
Quite often they think wrong! And by discussing a certain event, or a certain person, again and again, they may remember extra details.'
sentences.translation: في كثير من الأحيان يفكرون بشكل خاطئ! ومن خلال مناقشة حدث معين، أو شخص معين، مراراً وتكراراً، قد يتذكرون تفاصيل إضافية.

sentences.text: It did not seem to me to be a very good idea.
sentences.translation: لم يبدُ لي أنها فكرة جيدة جداً.

sentences.text: 'You do not agree with me?' said Poirot. 'Then a servant girl is cleverer than you.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: He handed me a letter. It was clearly written.
sentences.translation: سلمني رسالة. كانت مكتوبة بوضوح.

sentences.text: Dear Sir, - I hope you don't mind me writing to you. I have been thinking a lot since those awful two murders like poor auntie's.
sentences.translation: عزيزي سيدي، - آمل ألا تمانع في كتابتي إليك. لقد كنت أفكر كثيراً منذ هاتين الجريمتين المروعتين مثل جريمة عمتي المسكينة.

sentences.text: I saw the young lady's picture in the paper, the sister of the young lady who was killed at Bexhill.
sentences.translation: رأيت صورة الشابة في الصحيفة، أخت الشابة التي قُتلت في بيكسهيل.

sentences.text: I wrote to her to tell her I was coming to London and asked if I could come to her. Perhaps if we talked about it together, we might find out something.
sentences.translation: كتبت إليها لأخبرها أنني قادمة إلى لندن وسألت إن كان بإمكاني القدوم إليها. ربما إذا تحدثنا عن الأمر معاً، قد نكتشف شيئاً.

sentences.text: The young lady wrote back to me and suggested I might write to you. She said she'd been thinking the same.
sentences.translation: ردت عليّ الشابة واقترحت أن أكتب إليك. قالت إنها كانت تفكر في نفس الشيء.

sentences.text: She said we ought to work together. So I'm coming to London, and this is my address.
sentences.translation: قالت إنه يجب أن نعمل معاً. لذا أنا قادمة إلى لندن، وهذا عنواني.

sentences.text: Yours, Mary Drower
sentences.translation: مخلصتك، ماري دراور

sentences.text: 'Mary Drower,' said Poirot, 'is a very intelligent girl.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو،

sentences.text: He picked up another letter. It was a note from Franklin Clarke, saying that he was coming to London. He would visit Poirot the following day.
sentences.translation: رفع رسالة أخرى. كانت ملاحظة من فرانكلين كلارك، يقول فيها إنه قادم إلى لندن. سيزور بوارو في اليوم التالي.

sentences.text: 'Do not worry, mon ami' said Poirot. 'There will be action.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: Franklin Clarke arrived at three o'clock on the following afternoon.
sentences.translation: وصل فرانكلين كلارك في الساعة الثالثة من بعد ظهر اليوم التالي.

sentences.text: 'Monsieur Poirot,' he said, 'I'm still not satisfied. I'm sure that Crome is a very good officer, but he annoys me.'
sentences.translation: قال،

sentences.text: He seems to think he knows best! My idea is, Monsieur Poirot, that we mustn't delay. We've got to get ready for the next crime.
sentences.translation: يبدو أنه يعتقد أنه يعرف الأفضل! فكرتي هي، سيد بوارو، أننا يجب ألا نتأخر. يجب أن نستعد للجريمة القادمة.

sentences.text: I suggest that we form a kind of special legion - of the friends and relatives of the murdered people.
sentences.translation: أقترح أن نشكل نوعاً من الفيلق الخاص - من أصدقاء وأقارب الأشخاص المقتولين.

sentences.text: 'If we talk about things together, we might be able to find out something new.'
Also, when the next warning comes, one of us might recognise somebody who was near the scene of an earlier crime.
sentences.translation: أيضاً، عندما يأتي التحذير التالي، قد يتعرف أحدنا على شخص كان قريباً من مسرح جريمة سابقة.

sentences.text: 'My brother was a rich man and he left me some money. I can pay for everything. So I suggest the members of the special legion are paid for their services the same way as in a normal job.'
I suggest myself, Miss Barnard and Mr Donald fraser, who was planning to marry the dead girl. Then there is a niece of the Andover woman - Miss Barnard knows her address.'
sentences.translation: أقترح نفسي، والآنسة بارنارد، والسيد دونالد فريزر، الذي كان يخطط للزواج من الفتاة الميتة. ثم هناك ابنة أخت المرأة أندوفر - الآنسة بارنارد تعرف عنوانها.

sentences.text: 'Nobody else?'
'Well - er - Miss Grey.' As he spoke her name, Franklin Clarke suddenly looked much younger. He looked like a shy schoolboy.
sentences.translation: بينما ذكر اسمها، بدا فرانكلين كلارك فجأة أصغر بكثير. بدا مثل تلميذ خجول.

sentences.text: 'Yes. You see, Miss Grey worked for my brother for over two years. She knows the countryside and the people round there.'
I've been away for a year and a half in China, looking for things for my brother's art collection.'
sentences.translation: كنت بعيداً لمدة عام ونصف في الصين، أبحث عن أشياء لمجموعة أخي الفنية.

sentences.text: 'Very interesting,' said Poirot. 'Well, Mr Clarke, I agree with your idea.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: A few days later, the 'Special Legion' met at Poirot's rooms.
sentences.translation: بعد بضعة أيام، اجتمع
في غرف بوارو.

sentences.text: Each of the three girls was attractive in a different way - the fair beauty of Thora Grey, the dark looks of Megan Barnard, and Mary Drower with her pretty, intelligent face.
sentences.translation: كانت كل من الفتيات الثلاث جذابة بطريقة مختلفة - جمال ثورا غراي الأشقر، ومظهر ميغان بارنارد الداكن، وماري دراور بوجهها الجميل الذكي.

sentences.text: The two men were also very different. Franklin Clarke was big and talked a lot, and Donald Fraser was very quiet.
sentences.translation: كان الرجلان أيضاً مختلفين جداً. كان فرانكلين كلارك كبيراً ويتحدث كثيراً، وكان دونالد فريزر هادئاً جداً.

sentences.text: Poirot made a little speech.
sentences.translation: ألقى بوارو خطاباً قصيراً.

sentences.text: 'Here we have three murders - an old woman, a young girl, an older man.'
Only one thing connects these three people - the fact that the same person killed them.
sentences.translation: شيء واحد فقط يربط بين هؤلاء الأشخاص الثلاثة - حقيقة أن نفس الشخص قتلهم.

sentences.text: This means that the same person was present in three different places and was seen by a large number of people. He is a madman, but he does not look like one.
sentences.translation: هذا يعني أن نفس الشخص كان حاضراً في ثلاثة أماكن مختلفة ورآه عدد كبير من الناس. إنه مجنون، لكنه لا يبدو كذلك.

sentences.text: 'But he did not murder his victims by chance. He chose them on purpose.'
And he spent time finding out about the places where they lived before the murders.
sentences.translation: وأمضى وقتاً في معرفة الأماكن التي عاشوا فيها قبل الجرائم.

sentences.text: I refuse to believe that there is no clue which can help us find out who he is.
sentences.translation: أرفض الاعتقاد بأنه لا يوجد دليل يمكن أن يساعدنا في معرفة من هو.

sentences.text: One of you - or possibly all of you - knows something that they do not know they know.'
sentences.translation: أحدكم - أو ربما كلكم - يعرف شيئاً لا يعرف أنه يعرفه.

sentences.text: 'Words!' said Megan Barnard. 'It's just words. It doesn't mean anything.'
sentences.translation: قالت ميغان بارنارد.

sentences.text: 'Well, I think it's a good idea,' said Mary Drower. 'When you're talking about things, you often seem to understand more clearly.'
sentences.translation: قالت ماري دراور.

sentences.text: Poirot asked everyone in turn to tell the others what they remembered of the time before the murder.
sentences.translation: طلب بوارو من الجميع بدورهم إخبار الآخرين بما يتذكرونه من الوقت قبل الجريمة.

sentences.text: First Franklin Clarke spoke, and then Thora Grey, about Sir Carmichael Clarke's last day.
sentences.translation: تحدث فرانكلين كلارك أولاً، ثم ثورا غراي، عن اليوم الأخير للسير كارمايكل كلارك.

sentences.text: Next, Megan Barnard and Donald Fraser talked about Betty Barnard.
sentences.translation: بعد ذلك، تحدثت ميغان بارنارد ودونالد فريزر عن بيتي بارنارد.

sentences.text: Finally Mary Drower spoke about the last letter she had received from her aunt.
sentences.translation: أخيراً تحدثت ماري دراور عن آخر رسالة تلقتها من عمتها.

sentences.text: 'She said she wanted me to go to see her on my free day - and she said we'd go to the cinema.'
It was going to be my birthday, sir.' Suddenly Mary started to cry. 'You must forgive me, sir. I don't want to be silly. Crying's no good.'
sentences.translation: كانت ستصادف عيد ميلادي يا سيدي.
يجب أن تسامحني يا سيدي. لا أريد أن أكون سخيفة. البكاء لا فائدة منه.

sentences.text: It was the thought of her - and me - looking forward to our day out.'
sentences.translation: كانت فكرة أنها - وأنا - نتطلع إلى يومنا معاً.

sentences.text: 'I know just how you feel.' said Franklin Clarke. 'It's always the little things that upset you - like remembering a present, or something fun.'
sentences.translation: قال فرانكلين كلارك.

sentences.text: Megan said with a sudden warmth, 'That's true. The same thing happened after Betty died.'
sentences.translation: قالت ميغان بدفء مفاجئ:

sentences.text: Mum had bought some stockings for her as a present - bought them the same day it happened. Poor mum, she was so upset.
sentences.translation: اشترت أمي بعض الجوارب لها كهدية - اشترتها في نفس يوم الحادث. أمي المسكينة، كانت مستاءة جداً.

sentences.text: I found her crying over them She kept saying -
sentences.translation: وجدتها تبكي فوقها. ظلت تقول -

sentences.text: Her voice shook. She bent forward, looking straight at Franklin Clarke.
sentences.translation: ارتجف صوتها. انحنت إلى الأمام، ناظرة مباشرة إلى فرانكلين كلارك.

sentences.text: 'I know,' he said. 'I know exactly.'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: 'Aren't we going to make any plans for the future?' asked Thora Grey.
sentences.translation: سألت ثورا غراي.

sentences.text: 'Of course,' said Franklin Clarke. 'I think that when the fourth letter comes, we ought to work together.'
sentences.translation: قال فرانكلين كلارك.

sentences.text: 'I could make some suggestions,' said Poirot. 'I think it is just possible that the waitress Milly Higley might know something useful.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: I suggest two ways to find out. You, Miss Barnard, could start an argument with the girl. Say you knew she never liked your sister - and that your sister had told you all about her.
sentences.translation: أقترح طريقتين لمعرفة ذلك. أنتِ يا آنسة بارنارد، يمكنك أن تبدأي جدالاً مع الفتاة. قولي إنك كنت تعرفين أنها لم تحب أختك أبداً - وأن أختك أخبرتك بكل شيء عنها.

sentences.text: She will tell you exactly what she thought of your sister.
sentences.translation: ستخبرك بالضبط بما فكرت به عن أختك.

sentences.text: 'The other way is that Mr Fraser could pretend to be interested in the girl.'
'Is that necessary?' asked Donald Fraser.
sentences.translation: سأل دونالد فريزر.

sentences.text: 'No, it is not necessary. It is just one way to find out more information.'
'Shall I try?' asked Franklin Clarke. 'Let me see what I can do with the young lady.'
sentences.translation: سأل فرانكلين كلارك.

sentences.text: 'You've got your own part of the world to look after,' said Thora Grey rather sharply.
sentences.translation: قالت ثورا غراي بحدة نوعاً ما.

sentences.text: 'I don't think there is much you can do down there for the present,' said Poirot. 'Mademoiselle Grey is more suitable for -' Thora Grey interrupted him.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.
قاطعته ثورا غراي.

sentences.text: 'But, you see, Monsieur Poirot, I have left Devon now.'
'Miss Grey very kindly stayed to help me organise everything,' said Franklin Clarke. 'But naturally she prefers a job in London.'
sentences.translation: قال فرانكلين كلارك.

sentences.text: Poirot looked from one to the other.
sentences.translation: نظر بوارو من أحدهما إلى الآخر.

sentences.text: 'How is Lady Clarke?' he asked.
sentences.translation: سأل.

sentences.text: I was admiring the pale colour in Thora Grey's face and almost missed Clarke's reply.
sentences.translation: كنت أتأمل اللون الشاحب في وجه ثورا غراي وكدت أفوّت رد كلارك.

sentences.text: 'Not good. I wonder if you could come down to Devon and visit her, Monsieur Poirot? She said she would like to see you.'
'Certainly, Mr Clarke. Shall we say the day after tomorrow?'
'Good. I'll tell the nurse.'
'You, my child,' said Poirot, turning to Mary, 'I think you might perhaps do useful work in Andover.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو، متجهاً إلى ماري،

sentences.text: Try talking to the children. There were a lot of children playing in the street where your aunt lived. Perhaps they noticed who went in and out of your aunt shop.'
sentences.translation: حاولي التحدث مع الأطفال. كان هناك الكثير من الأطفال يلعبون في الشارع حيث عاشت عمتك. ربما لاحظوا من كان يدخل ويخرج من متجر عمتك.

sentences.text: 'Shall I put an advertisement in a newspaper?' asked Clarke. 'Something like this: ABC. Urgent, H P is close behind you. Give me a hundred pounds for my silence. X Y Z. It might make him show himself.'
sentences.translation: سأل كلارك.

sentences.text: 'It is possible to try,' said Poirot. 'But I think that ABC will be too clever to reply.' He smiled.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.
ابتسم.

sentences.text: 'Mr Clarke, I think you are like a boy in your heart.'
'Well,' Clarke said, looking at his notebook, 'we're making a start.'
sentences.translation: قال كلارك، ناظراً إلى دفتر ملاحظاته،

sentences.text: CHAPTER EIGHT
sentences.translation: الفصل الثامن

sentences.text: A Sick Lady
sentences.translation: سيدة مريضة

sentences.text: Poirot returned to his seat and sat down.
sentences.translation: عاد بوارو إلى مقعده وجلس.

sentences.text: 'It is unfortunate that she is so intelligent,' he said quietly.
sentences.translation: قال بهدوء.

sentences.text: 'Megan Barnard. Mademoiselle Megan.
she says. She realises that there is no meaning in anything I am saying. Nobody else noticed.'
sentences.translation: كلمات

sentences.text: 'Didn't you mean what you said?'
'I simply said the same thing many times.'
'But why?'
'Eh bien - to start - shall we say - the conversations. And there is something else, Hastings.'
Murder can often help people find romance.'
sentences.translation: غالباً ما يمكن للقتل أن يساعد الناس في العثور على الرومانسية.

sentences.text: 'Poirot!' I cried. I was shocked. 'I'm sure none of these people was thinking of anything except -'
sentences.translation: صرخت. كنت مصدوماً.

sentences.text: 'Did you see how Franklin Clarke suddenly bent forward and looked at Mademoiselle Megan?'
And did you also notice how annoyed Mademoiselle Thora Grey was about it? And Mr Donald Fraser, he -'
sentences.translation: وهل لاحظت أيضاً كم كانت الآنسة ثورا غراي منزعجة من ذلك؟ والسيد دونالد فريزر، هو -

sentences.text: 'Poirot,' I said. 'You have a very romantic mind.'
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: Suddenly the door opened. To my great surprise, Thora Grey entered.
sentences.translation: فجأة فُتح الباب. ولدهشتي الكبيرة، دخلت ثورا غراي.

sentences.text: 'Forgive me for coming back,' she said. 'But there was something that I think I would like to tell you, Monsieur Poirot'
sentences.translation: قالت.

sentences.text: 'Certainly, mademoiselle. Please sit down.'
Thora Grey sat down and began to speak, choosing her words carefully.
sentences.translation: جلست ثورا غراي وبدأت تتحدث، تختار كلماتها بعناية.

sentences.text: 'Mr Clarke told you that I decided to leave Combeside. He is a very kind and loyal person. But it is not quite like that.'
Lady Clarke wished me to leave. She is very ill, and her brain is confused because of the drugs they give her.
sentences.translation: الليدي كلارك أرادتني أن أرحل. إنها مريضة جداً، وعقلها مشوش بسبب الأدوية التي يعطونها لها.

sentences.text: The drugs make her suspicious and imaginative. She started to dislike me and told me to leave the house.'
sentences.translation: تجعلها الأدوية مرتابة وخيالية. بدأت تكرهني وأخبرتني أن أترك المنزل.

sentences.text: I admired the girl's honesty.
sentences.translation: أعجبتني صراحة الفتاة.

sentences.text: 'It's very good of you to come and tell us this,' I said.
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: 'It's always better to be honest she said with a little smile. 'It was rather a shock to me,' she said sadly. 'I had no idea Lady Clarke disliked me so much.'
sentences.translation: قالت بابتسامة صغيرة.
قالت بحزن.

sentences.text: In fact, I always thought she was rather fond of me.' She got up. 'That's all that I came to say. Goodbye.'
sentences.translation: في الواقع، كنت أعتقد دائماً أنها كانت مغرمة بي نوعاً ما.
هذا كل ما جئت لأقوله. وداعاً.

sentences.text: I went downstairs with her.
sentences.translation: نزلت معها الدرج.

sentences.text: When I came back, I said, 'I think that was very brave of her.'
sentences.translation: عندما عدت، قلت:

sentences.text: 'Do you know,' said Poirot, 'I am sure that already, in our conversations this afternoon, something important was said.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو،

sentences.text: It is strange - I do not know exactly what it was... something that reminded me of something which I had already seen or heard or noted...'
sentences.translation: إنه غريب - لا أعرف بالضبط ما كان... شيء ذكرني بشيء كنت قد رأيته أو سمعته أو لاحظته بالفعل...

sentences.text: 'Something at Churston?'
'No, not at Churston... before that... It doesn't matter. I will remember.'
A few days later we went down to Combeside again to see Lady Clarke. It was a September day at the beginning of autumn.
sentences.translation: بعد بضعة أيام ذهبنا إلى كومبسايد مرة أخرى لرؤية الليدي كلارك. كان يوماً من سبتمبر في بداية الخريف.

sentences.text: There was a deep sadness surrounding the house. The downstairs rooms were closed.
sentences.translation: كان هناك حزن عميق يحيط بالمنزل. كانت الغرف في الطابق السفلي مغلقة.

sentences.text: We were shown into a small room where a hospital nurse came to meet us.
sentences.translation: أُدخلنا إلى غرفة صغيرة حيث جاءت ممرضة للقائنا.

sentences.text: 'Monsieur Poirot?' she asked. 'I'm Nurse Capstick'
sentences.translation: سألت.

sentences.text: 'How is Lady Clarke?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Not bad. One can't hope for much improvement, of course, but some new treatment has made things a little easier for her.'
'I suppose her husband's death was a terrible shock?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Well, Monsieur Poirot,' said the nurse, 'Lady Clarke doesn't always know what's happening because of the drugs.'
sentences.translation: قالت الممرضة،

sentences.text: 'Were she and her husband very fond of each other?'
'Oh, yes, they were a very happy couple. He was very worried and upset about her, poor man. But he was often busy with his art collection. Miss Grey helped him with that.'
'Oh, yes - Miss Grey. She has left, has she not?'
'Yes - I'm very sorry about it. Sometimes ladies get strange ideas when they're not well.'
She led us upstairs to a room on the first floor. It had been a bedroom but was now a cheerful-looking sitting-room.
sentences.translation: قادتنا إلى الطابق العلوي إلى غرفة في الطابق الأول. كانت غرفة نوم لكنها أصبحت الآن غرفة جلوس مبهجة.

sentences.text: Lady Clarke was sitting in a big armchair near the window. She was very thin, and her face had the grey look of one who suffers much pain.
sentences.translation: كانت الليدي كلارك جالسة في كرسي كبير ذي مساند قرب النافذة. كانت نحيفة جداً، وكان على وجهها المظهر الرمادي لمن يعاني من ألم شديد.

sentences.text: 'This is Monsieur Poirot, who you wanted to see,' said Nurse Capstick.
sentences.translation: قالت الممرضة كابستيك.

sentences.text: 'Oh, yes, Monsieur Poirot said Lady Clarke, giving him her hand.'
sentences.translation: قالت الليدي كلارك، وهي تعطيه يدها.

sentences.text: 'My friend Captain Hastings. Lady Clarke.'
'How do you do? So good of you both to come.'
We sat down. There was a silence.
sentences.translation: جلسنا. كان هناك صمت.

sentences.text: 'It was about Car's death, wasn't it?' said Lady Clarke at last.'
sentences.translation: قالت الليدي كلارك أخيراً.

sentences.text: Oh, yes. I told franklin to ask you to come. I hope Franklin isn't going to be foolish... Men are so easily fooled... They are like boys... especially Franklin.'
sentences.translation: أوه، نعم. أخبرت فرانكلين أن يطلب منك القدوم. آمل ألا يكون فرانكلين أحمق... الرجال يُخدعون بسهولة... إنهم مثل الصبية... خاصة فرانكلين.

sentences.text: 'Did you want to say something about your husband's death?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Car's death? Yes,... Mad, poor man - the murderer, I mean. I've always been sorry for mad people - their heads must feel so strange.'
You haven't caught him yet?' she asked. 'Surely somebody saw him around here that day.'
sentences.translation: ألم تقبضوا عليه بعد؟
بالتأكيد رأى أحدهم هنا ذلك اليوم.

sentences.text: 'There were so many strangers, Lady Clarke. It is the holiday season.'
'Yes - I forgot. But they stay down by the beaches.'
'No stranger came to the house that day,' said Poirot.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Who says so?' asked Lady Clarke in a voice that was surprisingly strong.
sentences.translation: سألت الليدي كلارك بصوت كان قوياً بشكل مفاجئ.

sentences.text: 'The servants,' said Poirot. 'Miss Grey.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: Lady Clarke said very clearly, 'That girl a liar!'
sentences.translation: قالت الليدي كلارك بوضوح شديد:

sentences.text: I felt shocked. Poirot looked at me quickly.
sentences.translation: شعرت بالصدمة. نظر إليّ بوارو بسرعة.

sentences.text: 'I didn't like her. I've never liked her. I sent her away.'
Franklin said she might be a help to me. Franklin's a fool! I didn't want him getting mixed up with her.
sentences.translation: قال فرانكلين إنها قد تكون عوناً لي. فرانكلين أحمق! لم أرد أن يتورط معها.

sentences.text: I said.
sentences.translation: قلت.

sentences.text: There's one good thing about being ill - men can't argue with you. He did what I said and she went.'
sentences.translation: هناك شيء جيد واحد في المرض - لا يستطيع الرجال المجادلة معك. فعل ما قلته ورحلت.

sentences.text: 'Why did you say that Miss Grey was a liar?' asked Poirot.
sentences.translation: سأل بوارو.

sentences.text: 'Because she is. She told you that no strangers came to the house. But I saw her, with my own eyes, talking to a strange man on the front doorstep.'
It was the morning of the day Car died - about eleven o'clock.'
sentences.translation: كان صباح يوم وفاة كار - حوالي الساعة الحادية عشرة.

sentences.text: 'What did this man look like?'
'An ordinary sort of man. Nothing special.' A look of pain came over her face. 'Please - you must go now - I'm a little tired -'
sentences.translation: ظهرت نظرة ألم على وجهها.

sentences.text: 'That's a very strange story,' I said to Poirot as we travelled back to London. About Miss Grey and a strange man.'
sentences.translation: قلت لبوارو بينما كنا نعود إلى لندن.

sentences.text: 'You see, Hastings? There is always something to be found out.'
'Why did the girl lie about it and tell us she had seen no one?'
'The easiest way to answer the question is to ask her.'
'It's unbelievable that a girl like her would help a madman.'
'Exactly - so I do not believe it'
'Lady Clarke doesn't like her because she good-looking I said.'
'Perhaps Lady Clarke is right,' said Poirot. 'Perhaps her husband and Franklin Clarke are wrong - and Captain Hastings.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: He looked at me in an amused way. 'You always want to help good-looking girls in trouble.'
sentences.translation: نظر إليّ بطريقة مستمتعة.

sentences.text: 'How silly you are,' Poirot said, laughing.
sentences.translation: قال بوارو، ضاحكاً.

sentences.text: When we arrived home, we were told that a gentleman was waiting to see Poirot. my surprise it was Donald Fraser.
sentences.translation: عندما وصلنا إلى المنزل، قيل لنا إن رجلاً ينتظر لرؤية بوارو. ولدهشتي كان دونالد فريزر.

sentences.text: He seemed very embarrassed and shy. Poirot invited him to have sandwiches and a glass of wine with us.
sentences.translation: بدا محرجاً وخجولاً جداً. دعاه بوارو لتناول شطائر وكأس نبيذ معنا.

sentences.text: After we had eaten, Poirot said, 'You have come from Bexhill, Mr Fraser?'
sentences.translation: بعد أن أكلنا، قال بوارو:

sentences.text: 'Yes.' He stopped. 'I don't know why I've come to you!' he said suddenly.
sentences.translation: توقف.
قال فجأة.

sentences.text: 'I know,' said Poirot. 'There is something that you must tell someone. You are quite right. I am the correct person. Speak!'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: Fraser looked at him gratefully.
sentences.translation: نظر إليه فريزر بامتنان.

sentences.text: 'Monsieur Poirot, do you know anything about dreams? I've had the same dream for three nights. I think I'm going mad.'
I'm on the beach, looking for Betty. She's lost - only lost, you understand. I've got to find her. I've got to give her her belt. I'm carrying it in my hand. And then -'
sentences.translation: أنا على الشاطئ، أبحث عن بيتي. إنها ضائعة - ضائعة فقط، كما تفهم. يجب أن أجدها. يجب أن أعطيها حزامها. أنا أحمله في يدي. وبعد ذلك -

sentences.text: 'Yes?'
'The dream changes... I'm not looking any more. She's there in front of me - sitting on the beach. She doesn't see me coming.'

I come up behind her... she doesn't hear me... I put the belt round her neck and pull... She's dead... I've strangled her - and then her head falls back and I see her face... and it's Megan - not Betty!'
sentences.translation: أقترب من خلفها... لا تسمعني... أضع الحزام حول رقبتها وأشد... إنها ميتة... لقد خنقتها - ثم يسقط رأسها للخلف وأرى وجهها... إنه ميغان - ليس بيتي!

sentences.text: He sat back, white and shaking.
sentences.translation: جلس إلى الوراء، شاحباً ويرتجف.

sentences.text: 'What's the meaning of it, Monsieur Poirot? Why does it come to me? Every night... I - I didn't kill her, did I?'
I don't know what Poirot answered, because at that moment I heard the postman's knock. I left the room and went to the letter-box. Then I rushed back into the living-room.
sentences.translation: لا أعرف ماذا أجاب بوارو، لأنني في تلك اللحظة سمعت طرق ساعي البريد. غادرت الغرفة وذهبت إلى صندوق الرسائل. ثم أسرعت عائداً إلى غرفة المعيشة.

sentences.text: 'Poirot,' I cried. 'It's come. The fourth letter.'
sentences.translation: صرخت.

sentences.text: He jumped up and took it from me. Then he opened it with his paper-knife. He spread it out on the table. The three of us read it together.
sentences.translation: قفز وأخذها مني. ثم فتحها بسكين الورق. نشرها على الطاولة. قرأناها نحن الثلاثة معاً.

sentences.text: Still no success? What are you and the police doing? Well, well, isn't this fun? Poor Mr Poirot, I'm quite sorry for you.
sentences.translation: لا نجاح بعد؟ ماذا تفعل أنت والشرطة؟ حسناً، حسناً، أليس هذا ممتعاً؟ سيد بوارو المسكين، أنا آسف جداً لك.

sentences.text: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again.
sentences.translation: إذا لم تنجح في البداية، حاول، حاول مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: We've got a long way to go still.
sentences.translation: لا يزال أمامنا طريق طويل لنقطعه.

sentences.text: The next little event will take place at Doncaster on 11 September.
sentences.translation: الحدث الصغير التالي سيقع في دونكاستر في 11 سبتمبر.

sentences.text: See you. ABC
sentences.translation: أراك. ABC

sentences.text: Inspector Crome came round from Scotland Yard. While he was still there, Franklin Clarke and Megan Barnard arrived.
sentences.translation: جاء المفتش كروم من سكوتلاند يارد. بينما كان لا يزال هناك، وصل فرانكلين كلارك وميغان بارنارد.

sentences.text: The girl explained that she, too, had come from Bexhill because she wanted to ask Clarke something.
sentences.translation: شرحت الفتاة أنها هي أيضاً جاءت من بيكسهيل لأنها أرادت أن تسأل كلارك شيئاً.

sentences.text: Crome wasn't very pleased to see everyone there. He became very official.
sentences.translation: لم يكن كروم سعيداً جداً برؤية الجميع هناك. أصبح رسمياً جداً.

sentences.text: 'I'll take this letter with me, Monsieur Poirot,' he said.
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: 'This time we've got to get this man,' said Clarke. 'I should tell you, Inspector, that we've formed our own legion to catch him.'
sentences.translation: قال كلارك.

sentences.text: I don't think your job is going to be easy. I think ABC has beaten you again.'
sentences.translation: لا أعتقد أن مهمتك ستكون سهلة. أعتقد أن ABC هزمك مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: 'I don't think people will be able to criticise our arrangements this time,' said Crome.'The fool has given us a lot of warning.'
sentences.translation: قال كروم.

sentences.text: The 11th isn't until next Wednesday. We have a lot of time to make this public in the newspapers.
sentences.translation: الحادي عشر ليس حتى الأربعاء القادم. لدينا الكثير من الوقت لجعل هذا علنياً في الصحف.

sentences.text: We shall warn everyone in Doncaster whose name begins with a D. Also, we'll move a lot of police into the town.'
sentences.translation: سنحذر كل شخص في دونكاستر يبدأ اسمه بحرف D. أيضاً، سننقل الكثير من الشرطة إلى البلدة.

sentences.text: Clarke said quietly, 'It's easy to see that you're not interested in sport, Inspector,'
sentences.translation: قال كلارك بهدوء:

sentences.text: Crome stared at him. 'What do you mean, Mr Clarke?'
sentences.translation: حدق كروم إليه.

sentences.text: 'Don't you realise that next Wednesday the St Leger is being run in Doncaster?'
The Inspector looked shocked.
sentences.translation: بدا المفتش مصدوماً.

sentences.text: 'That's true,' he said. 'Yes, that makes things more complicated...'
sentences.translation: قال.

sentences.text: We were all silent for a minute or two as we thought about the situation. There would be crowds on the race-course - the sport loving English public.
sentences.translation: صمتنا جميعاً لدقيقة أو دقيقتين بينما كنا نفكر في الموقف. سيكون هناك حشود على مضمار السباق - الجمهور الإنجليزي المحب للرياضة.

sentences.text: 'I believe,' said Clarke, 'that the murder will take place on the race-course - perhaps actually while the Leger is being run.'
sentences.translation: قال كلارك،

sentences.text: Inspector Crome got up and left, taking the letter with him.
sentences.translation: نهض المفتش كروم وغادر، آخذاً الرسالة معه.

sentences.text: We heard voices in the hallway. A few minutes later, Thora Grey entered. She went straight to Franklin Clarke and put a hand on his arm.
sentences.translation: سمعنا أصواتاً في المدخل. بعد بضع دقائق، دخلت ثورا غراي. ذهبت مباشرة إلى فرانكلين كلارك ووضعت يداً على ذراعه.

sentences.text: She spoke anxiously, waiting for his answer.
sentences.translation: تحدثت بقلق، منتظرة إجابته.

sentences.text: 'The Inspector told me there's another letter. Where's the murder going to be this time?'
'Doncaster - and on the day of the St Leger.'
We started discussing the matter. I felt that there was very little hope. What could a small group of six people do?
sentences.translation: بدأنا نناقش الأمر. شعرت أنه لم يكن هناك أمل يذكر. ماذا يمكن لمجموعة صغيرة من ستة أشخاص أن تفعل؟

sentences.text: CHAPTER NINE
sentences.translation: الفصل التاسع

sentences.text: The Hunt Begins
sentences.translation: يبدأ المطاردة

sentences.text: 'I know nothing about this man,' said Thora Grey.
sentences.translation: قالت ثورا غراي.

sentences.text: 'No, no, mademoiselle,' said Poirot. 'That is not true. Each one of us knows something about him. I am sure that the knowledge is there.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: Clarke shook his head.
sentences.translation: هز كلارك رأسه.

sentences.text: 'We don't know anything. None of us has ever seen him or spoken to him. We've tried to remember everything again and again.'
'Not everything!' said Poirot. For example. Miss Grey told us that she did not see or speak to any stranger on the day that Sir Carmichael was killed.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.

sentences.text: Thora Grey nodded. 'That's quite right.'
sentences.translation: أومأت ثورا غراي.

sentences.text: 'Is it? Lady Clarke told us, mademoiselle, that from her window she saw you standing on the front doorstep talking to a man.'
'She saw me talking to a strange man?' The girl seemed very surprised. 'Lady Clarke has made a mistake. I never - Oh! I remember now!'
sentences.translation: بدت الفتاة مندهشة جداً.

sentences.text: How stupid! But it wasn't important. Just one of those men who come round selling stockings. I was crossing the hall when he came to the door.'
sentences.translation: كم هذا غبي! لكنه لم يكن مهماً. مجرد أحد هؤلاء الرجال الذين يأتون لبيع الجوارب. كنت أعبر القاعة عندما جاء إلى الباب.

sentences.text: Poirot put his hands to his head. Everyone stared at him.
sentences.translation: وضع بوارو يديه على رأسه. حدق الجميع فيه.

sentences.text: 'Stockings,' he said quietly. 'Stockings... it is the connection - three months ago... the other day... and now. Bon Dieu, yes!'
sentences.translation: قال بهدوء.

sentences.text: He sat up straight and looked at me.
sentences.translation: جلس مستقيماً ونظر إليّ.

sentences.text: 'You remember, Hastings? In the shop at Andover. We went upstairs. On a chair in the bedroom was a pair of new stockings.'
And you, mademoiselle -' he turned to Megan, 'you spoke of your mother who cried because she had bought your sister some new stockings on the day of the murder...'
sentences.translation: وأنتِ يا آنستي -
تحدثتِ عن والدتك التي بكت لأنها اشترت لأختك بعض الجوارب الجديدة في يوم الجريمة...

sentences.text: He looked round at us all.
sentences.translation: نظر حولنا جميعاً.

sentences.text: 'You see? It is the same thing repeated three times. That cannot be coincidence.'
Remember Mrs Ascher's neighbour, Mrs Fowler. She talked about people who were always trying to sell you things - like stockings.
sentences.translation: تذكروا جارة السيدة آشر، السيدة فاولر. تحدثت عن أشخاص كانوا دائماً يحاولون بيعك أشياء - مثل الجوارب.

sentences.text: Tell me, mademoiselle,' he said to Megan, 'it is true, is it not, that your mother bought those stockings from someone who came to the door?'
sentences.translation: أخبريني يا آنستي،
هل صحيح أنه اشترت والدتك تلك الجوارب من شخص جاء إلى الباب؟

sentences.text: 'Yes - yes - she did... I remember now.'
'But what's the connection?' cried Franklin Clarke.
sentences.translation: صرخ فرانكلين كلارك.

sentences.text: 'I tell you, my friends, it cannot be coincidence. Three crimes - and each time, a man visits the area selling stockings.'
He turned to Thora. 'Describe this man,' he said.
sentences.translation: التفت إلى ثورا.
قال.

sentences.text: She looked at him. 'I can't... I don't know how... he had glasses, I think - and an old coat... He wasn't the sort of man you'd notice.'
sentences.translation: نظرت إليه.

sentences.text: 'You are quite right, mademoiselle,' said Poirot. '
Yes... You have described the murderer.'
sentences.translation: قال بوارو.
لم يكن نوع الرجل الذي تلاحظه.

sentences.text: Mr Alexander Bonaparte Cust sat without moving. His breakfast lay cold and untasted on his plate. He was reading a newspaper with great interest.
